'asho kyiphu sa༈ 3) mig
bod kyi lo rgyus zhib 'jug la nye bar mkho ba'i lo rgyas don chen re'u mig ke ta ka zhes bya ba bzhugs so/phun tshogs tshe ring gis rtsom sgrig byas pa/mi rigs dpe lhan khang /

gsal bshad/ bod rigs ni mes rgyal gyi spun zla mi rigs gzhan dang 'dra bar lo rgyas yun ring ba dang / gna' rabs kyi rig gnas phun sum tshogs pa'i mi ri'es shig yin/ de'i lo rgyus skor sngon byon mkhas dbang rnams kyis deb ther dang /chos 'byung / rnam thar sogs ji snyed pa brtsams yod cing / 'on kyang deb ther dang / chos 'byung / rnam thar mang por lo khams mi gsal ba'i skyon cha 'ba' zhig gnaso yod stobs bod kyi lo rgyus la zhib 'jug byed skabs dgos med kyi dka' ngal mang po 'phrad pa red/ de'i phyir bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas la brtag zhib gnang mkhan dge slob mang po'i skul ma dang rogs ram gnang ba'i 'og bod kyi lo rgyus don chen re'u mig 'di dag rtsom sgrig byas pa yin/lo rgyus don chen re'u mig 'di rtsom sgrig byed pa'i skabs su nga tshos rtsod sgrub dngos gtso smra ba dang lo rgyus dngos gtso smra ba'i lta ba dang / langs phyogs/ byed thabs bcas la brten nas lo ngo stong phrag gnyis tsam gyi lo rgyus don chen gtso bo rnams lo rgyus kyi go rim la gzhigs te don gsal ba dang /tshig nyung ba/ go bde ba bcas kyi sgo nas rtsom sgrig byas yod/ de'i nang don gtso bo ni lo ngo stong brag ring rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba dang / krung dbyang srid gzhung rim pas bod sa gnas kyi dbang 'dzin par gnang ba'i 'ja' sa dang / cho lo/ gser yig gser dam sogs skor dang /thon skyed lam lugs dang lag rtsal sogs gsar gtod byed tshul/ lo rgyus thog 1

gi 'bangs/ gyen log dang dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod skor/ lo rgyus mi sna gal chen rnams kyi 'khrungs lo dang 'das lo/ bod kyi gnas khyad par can khag phyag btab pa'i lo khams/ phyi'i btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi btsan 'dzul la ngo rgol dang mes rgyal mtha' mtshams brtan srung byas pa'i gnas tshul sogs bkod yod/lo rgyus re'u mig 'di bzhin gtso bo tun hong gi yig rnying khag dang /deb ther sngon po/ deb ther dmar po khag gnyis/ deb ther dkar po/ dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs/ chos 'byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ la dgas rgyal rabs/ yar lung jo bo'i chos 'byung / sba bzhed/ rlangs/ kyi pu ti bse ru/bka' chems mthong ba don ldan/ yum bu lha khang gi dkar chag khyung po rgod tshang gi lo rgyas/ thob rgyal sman ri dgon gyi dkar chag bstan rtsis re'u migargya yig gi sdob ther krung go'i lo rgyus chen mo dang / rgya gar ba'i lo rgyus chen mo/ bal po'i lo rgyas chen mo sogs tshad ldan yig rigs khag la dpyad zhib dang / go bsdur/༄ zhib 'jug bcas nan tan byas thog rtsom sgrig byas rung /rang nyid kyi chab srid dang / rig gnas/ lo rgyus shes bya sogs kyi chu tshad ha cang dman pas re'u mig 'dir skyon dang nor 'khrul mi nyung ba zhig yod nges la rgya che'i gzigs pa po dang / lhag par du rgya bod mkhas dbang rnams kyis skyon brjod dang bka' slob chu bo gang gā'i rgyun bzhin yod pa bcas dgongs 'jags 'tshal/bod spyongs dge 'os smob grwa chen mo'i dge ming ba gun tshogs tshe ring nas rab byung bcu drug pa'i chu khye lo'i smin 'i dkar phyogs spyi bzang po gsum pa'i nyin bris/

dkar chagalo rgyas don chen gnad bsdas/ ( 1 )rgyal cuphran sil ma bcu gnyir+sha kyi re'u mig (97)bur rgyal btsan po rim byon gyi re'u mig (99)sa skya'i srid 'dzin pa rim byon gyi re'u mig (108)phag gru'i sde srid rim byon gyi re'u mig (110)gtsang pa sde srid rim byon gyi re'u mig (113)tā la'i bla ma rim byon gyi re'u mig (114)pan chen sku phreng rim byon gyi re'u mig (119)sde srid dang srid skyong rim byon gyi re'u mig (124)bka' blon rim byon gyi re'u mig (132)bod bzhugs am ban rim byon gyi re'u mig (148)dga' ldan khri pa rim byon gyi re'u mig (161)bod kyi mdzangs mi bdun gyi re'u mig (184)bod kyi rtsal po che bdun gyi re'u mig (187)bod kyi gnas khyad par can khag btab pa'i lo khams re'u mig (189)pur rgyal btsan po khag gi bang so'i re'u mig (197)spyi lo dang bod kyi lo khams shan sbyar re'u mig (204)1

lo rgyus don chen gnad bsdus/ sbyi lo'i sngon gyi 126lor(1)/ u be ra'am gnya' khri btsan po rgyal sar bskos/ 'di ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog gi btsan po'am rgyal po dang po de yin/ tun hong nas thon pa'i bod kyi yig rnying las myi skyes pa chen po rnams rje pa'i gos gyon pa yang de nas byung zer ba ltar/ rje yi rgyal chas pas pa de yi dus nas dar ba ma zad/ pha shul bu 'dzin gyis rgyal brgyud 'dzin pa'i srol yang dar/ dus der yul yar klung du pho brang la snga ba yum bu lha khang bzhengs/ bon po rnams kyis u be ra btsan por mnga' gsol/ mthar bon rnams 4kyi chab srid dang dpal 'byor gyi khe phan mtshon mi thub stabs sum pa'i bon po so yong sogs kyis btsan po bkrongs/ dus der bran g.yog lam lugs kyi spyi tshogs su slebs pa gsal po yin nam snyam/ji lo'i dus rabs dang por(1)/ gri gum btsan po'i sku dus su bod kyi chab srid dang / dpal 'byor/ rig gnas sogs gong 'phel ches cher phyin/ ba glang 'bri g.yag ra lug khyim du gsos pa dang / spang brkos nas zhing kha bzos pa/ chu bed kyi las ka rgya cher spel nas phu chu yur bur drangs pa/ shing bsregs nas sol ba bton/ sol bas gter rdo bzhus nas gser dngul zangs lcags sogs 'don pa'i rig pa rnyed/ brjed chags ldan pa'i 'phying ba stag rtse pho brang bzhengs/ grong la snga ba 'phying ba stag rtse zhes pa 1

ltar/ 'phying yul du klung la grong brdal chags/ chu chen brnga ra bas mi thar zam pa btsugs/ 'khyar bon bod du dar/spyi lo'i dus rabs dang por(1)/ legs drug gi thog ma e zho legs kyi sku dus su/ de'i blon po lha bu mgo dkar gyis mdzangs pa'i las su zhing la dor kha brtsis/ 'brog la thul brtsis/ phu chu mda' ru drangs/mda' la chu ma rmo ba de nas dar/ zhes pa ltar zhing 'brog las rigs gong 'phel ches cher 'gro ba'i dgos mkho'i ched du zhing la dor kha dang 'brog la thul brtsis pa'i srol gtod/sbyi lo 67/ me yos/ gong ma han ming ti'i skabs su sangs rgyas chos lugs rgya gar nas rgya nag gi yul du dar/ de'i dus su paṇ+ḍa ta dzu ha lam zer ba bden pa mthong pa gnyis kyis rta dkar po gcig la theg pa chung ngu'i chos bkal nas rgya nag tu 'ongs/ da lta'i ho nan zhing chen khongs lo'o dbyang grong khyer gyi shar ngos su pa'i rma si zhes pa'i lha khang zhig bzhengs/ chos bsgyur/ de nas bzung sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba'i 'go tshugs/ 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgya nag tu dar ba'i lo rgyus skor rgya rigs kyi mkhas pa khag dbar 'dod tshul mi 'dra ba mang tsam 'dugasbyi lo 254(1)/ zhing rta/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan 'khrungs/de'i sku dus su rgya gar nas sman pa bai byi dang bai lha ma ba/nyis bod du phebs/sman pa gnyis kyis reg pa rtsa yi mdo dang / 'tsho ba zas kyi mdo/ sbyor ba sman gyi mdo/ gtar sreg dpyad kyi mdo/ rma chas bzo'i mdo rnams gnang / gzhan yang rtsa 'grel khog dbub dang / sa dpyang lag len sogs gnang / 'gro don rgya cher spel/sbyi lo 333 (1)/ chu sbrul/ paṇ+ḍi ta blo sems 'tsho dang / lo tsā ba 2

li the si rnam gnyis kyis gser shog ngos la bai ḍūr+yas bris pa'i pang kong phyag brgya dang / mdo sde za ma tog yid du 'ong ba'i glegs bam rnam gnyis/gser gyi mchod rten mu dra'i phyag rgya/ tsirnya ma ṇi'i skos phor rnam drug(yang deb ther 'ga' zhig tu/ g.yu yi mchod rten bang rim bzhi byas pa zhig byung zer/tsirnya ma ṇi'i skos phor zhes pa bcu gcig zhal yid bzhin nor bu'i gzungs kyi skos phor zhig dang / mu dra'i phyag rgya zhes pa tshad khru gang tsam gyi nor bu'i riṭa kyi rdo la yig drug rang byon yod pa zhig yin gsungs)sogs ska gsung thugs kyi rten rnams bod du gdan drangs/ de dag la gnyan po gsang r+sha zhes 'bod nas yum bu lha khang du bzhugs su gsol/ de nas bod la sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dbu brnyes/sbyi lo 374 (1)/ chu rta/ lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan dgongs pa 'das/ sbyi lo 579 (1)/ sa phag dmus long dkon pa bkra'am stag ri gnyan gzigs 'khrungs/ btsan po de yi sku dus su/ blon khri dor snang btsun mong gi bus bre phul srang bcos 'bru mar tshad la 'jal/ dga' gnyis tshong las mthun gnyis la lung bsdebs/ de gong bod na tshong dang bre srang med zer/sbyi lo 601 (1)/ lcags bya/ gnam ri srong btsan 'khrungs/ de yi sku dus su bod kyi rgyal phran khag gcig gyur bzo ba'i 'go tshugs/ rgya nag nas sman rtsis bod du dar/ ji lo 617 (1)/ me glang / gnam ri srong btsan dang / tshe spong bza' 'bri ma thod dkar gyi sras srong btsan sgam po pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur lha khang du 'khrungs/ pho brang byams pa mi 'gyur lha khang zhes pa de rgya ma khri khang gi nye 'gram du yin zer khang ro zhig da lta'ang dngos su mjal rgyu 'du/

spyi lo 619/ sa yos/ dmus long dkon pa bkra'am stag ri gnyan gzigs dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 630/ lcags stag (1)gnam ri srong btsan bgrang bya nyer dgur phebs skabs bkrongs/ (2)bal po'i rgyal po g.yang rgya'u gla rmos rgyal srid bzung 'bral rang 'gul gyis bod dang 'brel ba btsugs/ lag shes bzo las pa mang po bod du btang / (3)srong btsan sgam po btsan po'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/spyi lo 633/ sa sprul/ (1)srong btsan sgam pos sum bha sogs mtha' bzhi'i rgyal phran mang po dbang du bsdas/ rgyal sa lha sar spos/ de nas bzung lha sa ni bod kyi chab srid dang / da/la 'byor/ rig gnas bcas kyi lte gnas sa gyar/ (2)thon mi sam sto ṭa sogs bod phrag bcu drug tsam rgya gar ring rigi riri du btang / 'phags yul gyi paṇa chen bram ze li byin sogs kyi zhabs la gtugs/ la: warta sogs nub phyogs kyi yi ge rnams la dpe mdzad de gangs can bod kyi yi ge la༄ legs bcos mdzad/sbyi lo 634/ shing rta/ thang tha'e tsung dang srong btsan sgam po phan tshun pho nya mngags te skyes bskur res mdzad/ de ni thang gong ma dang bong kyi btsan po'i dbar mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba dngos su btsugs pa zhig yin/spyi lo 635/ zhing lug (1)dmar po ri yi steng du pho brang gi rmang gzhi bting / (2) thon mi sam sto ṭa dang / mgar stong btsan sogs gnye bo rta pa brgya bal yul du bal bzan khri btsun slong bar bskyod/byi lo 636/ me sprel/ zla 4tshes 8nyin blon chen mgar stong btsan sogs gnye bo rta pa brgya thang gi rgyal sa drang en du 'byor/ rgya bza' kong jo bod kyi btsan po 'i btsun mor gsol ras zhus kyang mi gnang /

sbyi lo 638/ sa khri/ srong btsan sgam po dang btsun mo mang bza' khri lcam gyi sras gung ri gung btsan 'khrungs/ kha cig gis de ni srong btsan sgam po'i sras ma yin zer/sbyi lo 639/ sa phag (1)bal bza' khri btsun srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor gdan drangs/ (2)kha cig tu lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi rmang gzhi bting zer/sbyi lo 641 / lcags thang / (1)rgya bza' kong jo mtsho yi pad+ma srong btsan sgam po'i btsun mor gdan drangs/ de ni rig pa'i gnas la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yod/ bod la lo 39tsam bzhugs te rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi mdza' mthun la shugs sgon dang bod mi rnams la phan pa rgya cher mdzad pas mtshan du'ang rgya bza' kong jo mtsho yi pad+ma zhes gsol/ (2)lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi ming gzhi bting / (3)khru 'brug dgon pa'am khru 'brug byams pa mi 'gyur lha khang bzhengs/ chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po dang rgya bza' kong jo der yun ring bzhugs skad/ (4)rgya bza' kong jos rgya nag nas bzo rigs mang po bskongs te ra mo che gtsug lag khang bzhings/ de phyir rgya btab ra mo che'am rgya stag ra mo che'ang zer/sbyi lo 648/ sa sprel/ thang gi pho nya wang zhon tshul sogs rgya gar du 'tshams 'drir skyod skabs rgya gar bas ngo log ste thang gi pho nya mang po bsad/ wang shon tshul gyis bod la dmag rogs bcol bas srong btsan sgam pos rta dmag khri tsho btang ste rgya gar ba'i zing cha snying 'jags su btang /sbyi lo 649/ sa bya/ (1)thang tha'e tsung dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ (2)thang po'o tsung gser khrir mnga' gsol/ des srong btsan sgam por mag pa'i cho lo dang / de nas ring min song mtshams mtsho sngon rgyal po 5

dang / spying lung zhes pa rgyal po'i cho lo gnang pa ma zad/ bod mi'i re 'dun ltar dar 'bu dang / shel/ a rag chu 'khor sogs bzo mi bzo rigs bod du btang /spyi 'otswa 650/ lcags khyi/ (1)chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po bgrang bya 33la phebs skabs rims nad 'gos te 'phan yul zal mo'i sgang du ska gshegs/ kha cig tu dgung lo brgyad cu lhag tsam du 'tsho zer yang de ni༄ don dngos dang mi mthun snyam/ btsan po gshegs pa'i rjes su thang gong ma chen pos ched mngags pho nya btang ste 'das mchod legs par gnang / (2)srong btsan sgam po'i gdung sras gung ri gung btsan srid khrir mnga' gsol/sbyi lo 653/ chu glang / yab gung ri gung btsan dang / yum 'a zha bza' yi sras mang srong mang btsan 'khrungs/sbyi lo 655/ zhing yos/ srong btsan sgam po'i sras gung ri gung btsan bgrang bya 18la son te dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo663/ chu phag mgar stong btsan gyis dmag mi 'bum tsho 'khrid nas gru gur dmag drangs/ gru gu'i dpon po ho ge bod du bros 'ongs/nub phyogs gru gu'i yul tsho chen po bcu bod kyi 'og tu bsdus/sbyi lo 665/ shing glang / kha cig tu mgar stong btsan grongs te rgya bod dbar sa cha'i rtsod pa mang du byung zer/sbyi lo 666/ me stag mgar stong btsan rgya gu'i yul nas tshur logasbyi lo 667/ me yos/ bod kyi blon chen mgar stong btsan dgongs pa rdzogs/ blon de ni chab srid dang dmag don gyi bya bar byang zhing chub pa zhig yin/ des thang gi lam lugs la mig dpe bltas nas bod du bkas bkod rgyud 'dzin gyi byed thabs mang tsam spel/ lhag par da rgya bod mi rigs dbar gyi /ma ni

mdza' brtse'i 'brel ba la phan pa'i bya ba mang po mdzad/ srong btsan sgam po dgongs pa rdzogs rjes gdung sras rnams la ram 'degs mdzad de chab srid legs par bskyangs pas bod la bka' drin lhag par che ba'i blon chen zhig yin/ sbyi lo 670/ lcags rta/ bod kyi dpung dmag gis thang la dmag drangs nas yan ji dang / chi'u tshe/ rgya'u sla/ yu'u tha'an bcas zhing chen po bzhi tshur blangs/spyi lo 672/ chu sprel/ bod kyi blon po 'jin 'jin rgya nag tu bskyod/ srong btsan sgam po zhal bzhugs pa'i skabs su rgya bod rig gnas spel res byed ched sku drag gi sras mang po bang gi rgyal sa drang man du slob sbyong du btang / blon po 'di yang chung dus nas rgya nag tu btang bas rgya yi skad yig rig gnas la shin tu mkhas par gyur/sbyi lo 675/ shing phag bod kyi btsan po mang srong mang btsan gyis blon po te re 'phan bu rgya nag tu btang / sngar gyi rgyal blon gong ma rnams kyi dgongs 'dun ltar/ thang bod bar mdza' mthun mnyam gnas dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan ji lta ji snyed gsol yang thang /'o tsung gis ma gsan par g.yul 'thab kyi bya ba brtsams/sbyi lo 676/ me byi/ (1) mang srong mang btsan gyi sras 'dus srong mang po rje 'khrungs/ (2) gong ma chen po thang ga'o tsung gis 'dum 'grigs la gsan 'jog med par bod dang g.yul 'thab/ bod dmag gis sha jo dang /ko jo/ he jo/ phun jo rnams bcom/ dpon rigs dang dmag mi mang po bsad/ nor phyugs rnams 'phrogasmri lo 679/ ba/ yos/ mang srong mang btsan dgung grangs nyer 7

bdun la phebs te gtsang bar snang sgang la dgongs pa 'das/ yang deb ther 'ga' zhig tu btsan po mang srong mang btsan me byi(676)lor sku gshegs kyang sa yos(679)lor gzhi nas khyab bsgrags byas zer/ dus der lha sras 'dus srong mang po rje sku na chung bas nang gi bya ba mtha' dag mgar gyi bu che bas byas/ phyi yi bya ba rnams mgar gyi bu chung ba dang tsha pos byas/ btsan po sku na son pa'i rjes su rgyal blon dbar mi mthun pa'i rkyen byung zer skad/spyi lo 680/ lcags 'drug rgya bza' kung jo mtsho yi pad ma bod la lo bzhi bcu tsam bzhugs te dgongs pa rdzogs/ bang so 'phyongs rgyas su brtsigs/sbyi lo 682/ chu lug thang ku'o tsung dgung lo nga drug tu phebs te dgongs pa rdzogs/ lcags sprel(660)lo nas thang ku'o tsung khrug shed mtho ba'i rkyen gyis don du chab srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag rgyal mo 'u rdzi than gyis mdzad zer rgya yig gi deb ther khag la 'khod/sbyi lo 692/ chu 'khrug (1)thang gi rgyal mo 'u rdzi than gyis dmag dpon chen po wang sha'o sogs khri dmag btang ste bod dang g.yul 'gyed/ shin cang khul gyi yan ji dang / chi' tshe/ hra' sla/ ya' tha'an cu ra ri ༄༄bcas zhing chen po bzhi blangs/ yul der srung dmag khri gsum tsam bzhag(2)khri lde gtsug brtan nam mes mag tshoms pho 4brang ldan mkhar du sku bltams/ yang deb ther 'ga' zhig tu lcags 'brug(680)lor sku 'khrungs zhes 'khod/sbyi lo 704/ shing 'khrug 'dus srong mang po rje mi nyag yul du gshegs/ btsan po de yi sku dus su/ bod nang khul dang mtha' bzhi'i rgyal khab khag dang dmag 'khrug yang yang langs/ rngog ring la nag po dang / rngog

chos lugs bkag 'gog byed pa'i bca' khrims med par bzos/ mang yul nas rten gtso jo bo shākya mu ni shing rtar gdan drangs te lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi gtsang khang dbus su bzhugs su gsol/sbyi lo 762/ chu stag yab khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras mu ne+e btsan po 'khrungs/spyi lo 763/ chu yos/ (1)thang bod dbar slar yang dmag 'khrug langs/ bod dmag gis thang gi rgyal sa drang man blangs/ thang gong ma tā tsung hran kra'u zhes pa'i sa gnas der bros/ bod dmag gis gyim shing kong jo'i tsha bo li dran hang gong ma'i khrir bskos/ bod dmag rnams tsha ba mi thegs pas nyin brdzu lnga tsam las ma bsdad par phyir log gong ma tā tsung sku 'khor dang bcas pa rgyal sar tshur log nas li dran hung bkrongs/ (2)mu rug btsan po 'khrungs/sbyi lo 764/ zhing 'drug khri srong lde'u btsan gyi sras mu tig btsan po 'khrungs/sbyi za 775/ shing yos/ (1)bsam yas mi 'gyur lhan gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang gi ming gzhi bting / (2)rgya gar nas marten chen bo ji gta dang slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas bod du gad drangs/ bod mi rab tu byung ba'i srol dar nas/ sba gsal snang dang / dbas khri sher/ sang shi ta/ pa gor be+e ro tsa na/ ngan lam rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ 'khon klu'i dbang po bsrungs ba/ rma rin chen mchog bcas sang mi mi bdun byung / sbyi lo 777/ me sprul/ kha cig tu mu tig btsan po sad na legs mjing yon rgyal sar bskos zer/sbyi lo 780/ lcags sprel/ thang rda tsung rgyal sar bskos/ des 10

pho nya btang lte bod dang mdza' mthun yong ba'i re ba brtan/myu lo 783/ chu phag kan su'u khongs chin rgyad ces pa'i sa gnas der thang bod dbar mna' sbrel dam bca' bzhag so shas ring zhi mthun mnyam gnas su gyur/ spyi lo 785/ shing glang mu ni btsan po sang na legs mjing yon rgyal sar bskos/sbyi lo 786/ me stag (1)thang bod dbar slar yang dmag 'khrug langs/ (2)g.yu thog snga ma yon tan mgon po 'khrungs yang deb ther 'ga' zhig tu sa sprel (spyi lo 768)lor 'khrungs zhes 'khod/ de'i ska dus su bod lugs kyi gso ba rig pa dar rgyas ches cher phyin/ dus der ga) thog yon tan mgon po dang be byi legs mgon/ 'ug pa chos bzang / cher rje zhig po/ mi nyag rong rje/ brang ti rgyal bzang / gnyag pa chos bzang / stod sman grags rgyal/ mtha' bzhi dar po bcas bod kyi sman pa mkhas can mi dgu byung /g.yu thog yon tan mgon pos phyi nang gi gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs la zhib 'jug legs par mdzad/ phyogs rigs kyi sman pa grags can mi dgu ste/rgya nag gi sman pa stong gsum dang / rgya gar gyi sman pa shidha ga / bal po'i sman pa da na shrī la/ kha che'i sman pa khu na badz+ra/ sog po'i sman pa na 'a shan dir pa/ dol po'i sman pa khyo ma ru rtse/ gru gu'i sman pa seng ge 'od can 'phel byed/ khrom rgya ge mu rje the khrom gyi sras btsan pa shi la na/ ma hā de wa bcas bod la gdan drangs nas gso rig gzhung lugs skor brtag zhib dang rtsod gleng rgya cher gnang /sbyi lo 787/ me yos/ bsam yas mi 'gyur lhan gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs zin nas dga' ston gzab rgyas bshazlos/11

skyes/ sbyi lo 798/ sa stag khri dar ma 'u dum btsan nam glang dar ma sbyi lo 803/ chu lug kha cig tu glang dar ma skyes zer/ji lo 806/ me khyi/ khri gtsug lde btsan nam ral pa can 'khrungs/sbyi lo 817/ me bya/ mu tig btsan po dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 821/ lcags glang / bod kyi pho nya rnams drang man du bskyod/ btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan dang / blon chen bran kha dpal gyi yon tan gyi bka' bzhin rgya bod mi rigs dbar mdza' brtse'i mthun lam yun gnas yong thabs skor bka' gros legs par mdzad/ drang man gyi nub ngos su rgya bod mna' mthun gyi rdo ring btsugs mna' por/sbyi lo 822/ chu stag thang gi pho nya rnams lha sar 'byor/ bod kyi btsan pos bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas mdzad/ blon chen bran kha dpal gyi yon tan sogs dpon rigs brgya lhag tsam dang thang gi pho nya rnams bka' gros legs par mdzad/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi mdun du dbon zhang rdo ring btsugs/ gnam la nyi zla zung gcig sa la btsan po dbon zhang zhes snyan pa'i gtam phyogs bzhi kun tu grags/sbyi lo 840/ lcags sprel/ blon po sbas stag sna sogs kyis g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba mang tsam spel nas btsun mo cog ro bza' dpal gyi ngang tshul dang blon chen bran kha dpal gyi yon tan lus 'brel byung skor rgyal por phra ma gsol bas/ btsan po khri gtsug lde btsan gyis khong gnyis khrims la sbyor zhig gsungs/btsun mor ma nyes kha g.yogs byung bas thugs shin tu skyo nas rang srog lcebs/bran kha dpal gyi yon tan bros song yang mthar bzung ste snye thang da dmar gsod btang / ༄12

sbyi lo 841/ lcags bya/ (1)khri gtsug m+bi btsan nam ral pa can 'bras chang gsol nas gzims pa'i skabs su blon po sbas stag sna dang cog ro lha lod(cog ro lha lung yang zer)sogs kyis zhal ltag pa'i ngos su gcus te bkrongs/ (2)glang dar mas bod kyi srid dbang bzung / sbyi lo 846/ me stag (1)lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes mda' 'phangs te glang dar ma bkrongs/ khri dar ma 'u dum btsan 'di ni mkhyen pa chung la rgyud gyong bas 'bangs rnams yi mi rangs par mtshan du'ang glang dar ma zhes btags/ de khrir 'khod pa'i rjes su/ bod la mi nad dang / phyugs nad/sad ser/ mu gi sogs rang byung khams kyi gnod pa tshad med byung / lhag par du btsan po de yis sangs rgyas chos lugs pa rnams rim pa gsum du phyes nas/ bla ma che khag dang / chos la dad pa gting zab yod mkhan rnams dmar gsod btang / spyir btang gi chos pa rnams ri dwags brngon du 'jug chos byed skyes bu'i ming tsam 'dzin pa rnams grub mtha' bsgyur nas bon gyi chos byed du 'jug pa sogs la brten 'bangs mi rnams yid ma rangs bar khri la 'khod nas lo shas las ma song bar bkrongs/ (2)glang dar ma'i sras 'od bsrungs dar ma bkrongs nas zla shas song mtshams su 'khrungs/sbyi lo 869/ sa glang / thog mar mdo khams yul nas dba' kho bzher legs steng gis lag dpon byas te 'bangs gyen log langs/ de nas rim bzhin dbu ru dang / g.yo ru sogs nas 'bangs gyen log langs/sbyi lo 877/ me bya/ 'bangs gyen log shugs chen langs te btsan po'i bang so mang che ba bshig zer/sbyi lo 892/ chu byi/ bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal 'khrungs/ji lo 909/ lhags bya/ kha cig tu glang dar mas dbus gtsang gi 13

bstan pa bsnubs zer/spyi lo 902/ chu khyi/ kha cig tu lha lung dpal gyi rdo rjes glang dar ma bkrongs zer/spyi lo 907/ me yos/ thang rgyal rabs 'thor zhig tu gyur/sbyi lo 958/ sa rta/ lo chen rin chen bzang po stod mnga' ris kyi gu ge'i sa char 'khrungs/ khong gis gsang sngags gsar ma dang rgya gar gyi sman gzhung mang po bod yig tu bsgyur/ nyin rda dang ni pa la'i sman bcos kyi lag len bod la dar spel gnang / ༄sbyi lo 978/ sa stag (1)mkhas grub khyung po 'khrungs/ de'i 'khrungs yul ni snye mo rdzong khongs ra mang yin/ rgya gar dang bal yul du chos slob par thengs bdun bskyod/ rjes su mnga' ris su a ti sha dang mjal/gtsang rnam gling gzhong gzhong dgon pa phyag btab ste shangs pa bka' brgyad kyi srol gtod/ dgung lo brgya dang lnga bcu bzhugs/ (2)thog mar mdo rād kyi yul nas bstan pa'i me ro bslangs te bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'go tshugs/ji lo 990/ lcags stag khyung po rnal 'byor ska bltams zer/7 spyi lo 993/ chu sprul/ 'brog mi lo tsā dro shākya gzhon nu sku 'khrungs / lo 1004/ shing 'drug 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byang gnas sku bltams zer/ cusbyi 44 1011/ lcagabasgyu phag nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung ska bltams/sbyi lo 1012/ chu byi/ mar pa the tsā ba 'khrungs/1 ji lo 1015/ zhing yos/ rnal 'byor pa a mes chen po 'khrungs/

spyi lo 1027/ me yos/ (1)dus 'khor rtsa 'grel 'phags yul nas bod du gdan drangs bas/ de nas rtsis 'go btsugs te rab byung dang po 'go tshugs/ (2)dge bshes po to ba rin chen gsal 'khrungs/ (3)nā ro pa mkha' spyod du gshegs/sbyi lo 1028/ sa 'drug dus 'khor rtsa 'grel bod kyi skad du bsgyur/sbyi lo 1030/ lcags lug (1) dge bshes po to ba rin chen gsal 'khrungs zhes deb ther sngon por 'khod/ (2) phu chung ba 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1032/ chu sprel/ stod lung pa chen po 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1034/ shing khyi/ sa skya'i 'khon dkon cog rgyal po 'khrungs/de'i 'khrungs yul gtsang du yin/ 'khon rigs gong ma rnams gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos lugs 'dzin/ khong gis 'brog mi lo tsā ba shākya ye shes kyi drung nas lam 'bras dang rgyad brtag gnyis sogs gsang sngags gsar ma mang du sbyangs nas mkhas padro gyur/ sa skya'i dgon pa btab/ de nas sa skya ba'i grub mtha' zhes grags che bar gyur/ dgung lo re dgu 'tsho/sbyi lo 1035/ zhing phag bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gshegs/sbyi lo 1036/ me byi/ rngog chos sku rdo rje 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1037/ me glang / nag tsho lo tsā ba jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha gdan 'dren par bskyod/ bstod pa ltar na jo bo rje rgya gar nas phebs par 'dod/sbyi lo 1039/ sa yos/ bstod pa dang lam rim ltar na jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha stod mnga' ris su phebs zer/spyi lo 1040/ lcags 'byag (1)deb ther mang che ba'i 'dod 15

tshul ltar na jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha 'phags yul gyi bai kra ma la shrī la'i gtsug lag khang nas phebs rdog thon/ (2)zha lu dgon pa btab/ (3)mi la thos pa dga' ba dang ba ri lo tsā'i ba sku bltams/ (4)na ro paṇa chen ba/shegs/sbyi lo 1041/ lcags sprul/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bal yul du phebes/sbyi lo 1042/ chu rta/ a ti sha bal yul nas mnga' ris su 'byor/ bod kyi mkhas grub paṇa chen rnams nas bsu ba dang zhabs tog gang legs mdzad/sbyi lo 1044/ shing sprel/ (1)jo bo rje a ti sha mnga' ris su bzhugs skabs 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byang gnas dang zhal mjal/ (2)rma lo tsā bste chos 'bar 'khrungs/ cuspyo lo 1047/ me phag jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha bsam yas su phebs/ dgun kha'i dus su snye thang du bzhugs/sbyi lo 1049/ sa glang / mu dra bas bo dong ma'i dgon pa phyag btab/sbyi lo 1054/ ging rta/ jo bo rje dpal ldan ma ti sha snye thang du sku gshegs/ bstan rtsis re'u mig ltar na dga' ldan du sku gshegs zer/sbyi lo 1055/ zhing lug (1)lo chen rin chen bzang po gshegs/ (2)mi sgom chos kyi shes rab dang / pa tshab lo tsā ba nyi ma graṭa/zhang ston chos 'bar bcas 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1056/ me sprel/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas kyis rwa theng dgon pa phyag btab pa deb sngon du gsungs/1

sbyi lo 1057/ me bya/ rwa sgong dgon pa phyag btab zer deb ther mang che bar bshad/sbyi lo 1059/ sa phag (1)rngog blo ldan shes rab dang / rngog shes rab rgya mtsho/ dol pa shes rab rgyal mtshan bcas 'khrungs/ (2)kha cig tu gsang bu dgon pa phyag btab zer/spyi lo 1060/ lcags byi/ (1)zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gshegs nas gdan sa glan tshul byang gis 'dzin/ (2)rma bya rnar ba 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1063/ chu yos/—'brom ston pa gshegs pa dga' ldan chos 'byung las gsungs/sbyi lo 1064/ zhing 'khrug 'brom ston pa dgongs pa rdzogs pa deb ther sngon por gsungs/ji lo 1065/ shing la/ 'brom ston pa dgongs pa rdzogs pa deb ther mang che bar gsungs/spyi 41 1073/ chu glang / (1)'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos dpal ldan sa skya dgon pa phyag btab/ (2)rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyis gsang phu sne'u thag btab/sbyi lo 1074/ shing stag (1)'brog mi lo tsā ba dang zur chung ba gnyis bde bar gshegs/ (2)sgro phug pa 'khrungs/spyi lo 1075/ shing yos/ (1)khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gshegs/ (2)khu sher brtson dang / bya yul pa gzhon nu 'od srungs 'khrungasasbyi zusgo 1079/ ba thagig (1)'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos bod kyi ma ga rta chen po dpal ldan sa skya btab ces deb ther 'ga' zhig tu gsungs/ (2) dwags po lha rje sku 'khrungs/17

sbyi lo 1083/ chu phag rwa sgreng du gdan sa pa med par chos/ kyi mu ge lo mang byung zer skad/sbyi lo 1084/ zhing byi/ ras chung ba dang / sne'u zur pa'i slob ma byang chub dge mdzes 'khrungs/zer/ spyi lo 1086/ me stag gtum ston blo gros grags pa 'khrungs sbyi lo 1087/ me yos/ rab byung gnyis pa 'go tshugs/sbyi cas 1088/ sa 'drug rgya ma sangs rgyas dpon ston 'khrungs/sbyi cas 1089/ sa sprul/ rma lo tsā ba chos 'bar sa dug gis bkrongs/sbyi lo 1092/ chu sprel/ sa chen kun dga' snying po gtsang sa skya'i khru ma zhes pa'i yul der 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyi shu la son skabs dpal ldan sa skya'i bdag po mdzad de rang lugs 'dzin spel skyong gsum gnang bar brten sa chen zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum 'tsho/sbyi lo 1093/ chu bya/ (1)glang ri thang pas glang thang dgon pa phyag btab/ (2)rje btsun mi la ras pas sgrub pa mthar phyin mdzad de gangs ti se sogs la gnas bskor du byon/sbyi 'os 1097/ :sgo glarngan / mar pa lo tsā ba gshegs/sbyi lo 1102/ chu rta/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dgongs pa rdzogs te ba ri lo tsā ba sa skya'i khrir phebs/spyi lo 1109/ sa glang / (1) rngog blo ldan shes rab gshegs/(2)dwags po lha rje mi la'i drung du byon/ (3)cha pa chos kyi seng ge 'khrungs/18 spyi lo 1110/ lcags stag (1)bde gshegs phag mo gru pa

'khrungs/ (2)karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa(mtshan dngos chos kyi grags pa)yis spu bka' brgyad kyi grub mtha'i srol gtod/ de'i 'khrungs yul ni dkar mdzes khul shing lodro rdzong ste tre shod gangs kyi rwa bar yin/ dgung lo sum cur phebs skabs dwags po lha rje bsten nas sangs rgyas kyi 'phrin las spel bar dam bca' bas rkarma pa(las sam 'phrin las kyi don yin)zhes ming thob/ des stod zung mtshur phu dgon phyag btab/ dgung lo brgyad cu gya gsum 'tsho/sbyi lo 1113/chu sprul/las chen kun rgyal sogs kyis bya yul dgon pa phyag btab/sbyi lo 1121/ lcags glang / dwags po lha rjes sgam po dgon pa btab/sbyi lo 1122/ chu stag kaḥthog dam pa bde gshegs mtshan dngos shes rab seng ge'am spobs pa mtha' yas rme shod kyi nye phyogs su 'khrungs/'di ni rnying ma ba'i mkhas grub chen po zhig yin/ 'dzam ston 'gro ba'i mgon po dang / rkarma dus gsum mkhyen pa sogs bla mar bsten/ sde dge gaḥthog dgon btab/ dgung lo bdun cu don gcig 'tsho/spyi lo 1123/ chu yos/ grub pa'i dbang po rje btsun mi la ras pa sku gshegs/sbyi lo 1124/ shing 'khrug mnga' bdag nyang ral pa 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1127/ me lug kha che paṇa chen shākya sri ska 'khrungs/spyi lo 1128/ sa sprel/ gling ras pa pad+ma rdo rje /khrungs/ 'di'i 'khrungs yul gtsang rgyal rtse yin/ khong ni bka' rgyad pa'i grub chen zhig yin pa dang / dgung lo so brgyad la phebs skabs phag je'i drung nas chos bslabs/khong gi slob ma gtsang pa rgya ras kyis skyid smad gnam gyi phur 'brug dgon pa 19

btab ste 'brug pa bka' brgyud kyi srol gtod/ dgung lo drug cu 'tsho/sbyi lo 1142/ chu khyi/ stag lung thang pa 'khrungs/ mtshan dngos stag lung thang pa chen po bkra shis dpal zer/ 'khrungs yul ni mdo khams g.yang skad pong ra steng du yin/ des stag lung dgon pa phyag btab/ stag lung bka' brgyud kyi srol gtod/ dgung lo drug cu re brgyad 'tsho/sbyi lo 1143/ chu phag 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dpal 'khrungs/ des 'bri gung bka' brgyud pa'i bstan pa'i srol gtod/sku chung ngu'i dus nas 'gro mgon phag gru'i drung nas chos bslabs/ 'bri gung dgon pa phyag btab/ mispyan snga pa grags pa'i 'byung gnas sogs slob ma mang du byung / dgung lo bdun cu don bzhi 'tsho/sbyi lo 1147/ me yos/ (1)rab byung gsum pa 'go tshugs/(2)sa skya'i rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan dang zhang gi slob ma mnyam med shākya ye shes 'khrungs/ tshosbyi lo 1148/ sa 'byug kun ldan ras pa gtsang shab smad la sku 'khrungs/ de ni bka' brgyud pa'i bla ma mkhas can zhig yin/ rje phag mo gru pre bla mar bsten/ rang gi dbon po khro phu lo tsā ba sogs slob ma mang du byung /spyi lo 1149/ sa tshul/ kha che paṇa chen rab tu byung ba deb sngon las gsungs/ cisbyi lo 1153/ chu bya/ gtum ston blo gros grags pas snar thang dgon pa phyag btab/ de ni bod rigs sa khul gyi par khang gal che ba khag gsum gyi bye brag gcig yin/ sgyuspyi lo 1155/ ging phag karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas gzhu'i grwa bzhi'i lha lung gi kurma dgon phyag btab/20

ji lo 1157/ me phag phag mo gru pa dang pha dam pa zhal mjal/spyi lo 1158/ sa stag phag mo gru pas gdan sa mthil phyag btab/sbyi lo 1159/ sa yos/ (1)ka thog pa dam pa bde gshegs kyis sde dge mi thog dgon pa phyag btab/ (2)karma pa dus gsum masan pa mtshur phur phebs/sbyi lo 1160/ lcags 'drug sgom tshul gyis lung bstan pa ltar lha sar zhig gso mdzad/sbyi lo 1165/ zhing bya/ bya 'chad ka bas mal gro 'chad rka'i dgon pa phyag btab/0 lo 1169/ sa glang / (1)karma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas 'dod spang phug btab/ (2)skyor mo lung gi dgon pa btab/sbyi lo 1172/ chu 'drug khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal sku bltams/ de ni bka' brgyud pa'i lo chen grags can zhig yin/ dgung lo nyer dgur phebs skabs byang dge ba zhes pa lo tsā ba mkhas pa zhig yod pa de'i drung nas lo tsā ba sbyangs te mkhas par gyur/ dgung lo nyer bzhi'i skabs su bal yul du phebs te chos bslabs/ de rjes grub chen mi tra dzo gi dang rmekha che paṇa chen shākya shri sogs gangs can gyi yul du gdan drangs nas chos dpe mang po bsgyur/ gtsang khro phu dgon pa phyag btab/ de nas bzung khong gi slob rgyad rnams khro phu bka' brgyud ces grags/ mthar dbus su dgongs pa rdzogs ༷sbyi lo 1173/ chu sprul/ kha cig tu khro phu lo tsā ba byams pa dpal 'khrungs zer/sbyi lo 1175/ zhing lug (1)bya 'chad ka ba dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ (2)tshal dgon pa phyag btab/21

btab/spyi lo 1179/ sa phag 'bri gung skyob pas 'bri gung dgon pa phyag sbyi lo 1180/ lcags byi/ stag lung thang pa bkra shes dpal gyis byang stag lung dgon pa phyag btab/ de nas bzung stag lung bka' brgyud ces ming grags/spyi lo 1182/ chu stag (1)yab rje phur ga ba dur dang btsun mo hu lun gyi sras jin gin rgyal po 'khrungs/ kha cig tu chu rta(1162)lor /lta/sa zer/ (2)sangs rgyas dbon ston gyis rgya ma rin sgang gsar ma sbyi lo 1189/ sa bya/ rkarma pa dus gsum mkhyen pas stod lung mtshur phu dgon pa phyag btab/sbyi lo 1190/ lcags khyi/ stod kyi ya rtse rgyal pos jo bor gser tog phul/sbyi lo 1192/ chu byi/ spru bas smra dgon btab/'das/sbyi lo 1193/ chu glang / kurma pa dus gsum mkhyen pa dgongs pa sbyi lo 1205/ thing glang / lo de nas bzung mong gol gyis mi nyag la dmag thengs gsum drangs/ dpon dmangs mang po bsad/ dngos po 'bor chen 'phrogaspyi 'osgo 1206/ me stag (1)karma pa sku phreng gnyis pa kurma pagi chab mdo 'jo mda' rdzong khongs byi le'i tshan tor zhes pa'i grong der 'khrungs/yon gong ma chen pos las zhwa nag po zhig bstsal pas kurma zhwa nag ces grags che bar gyur/ de la rjes su yang srid ngos 'dzin byas/ de nas bzung bod la 22

bla ma'i yang srid 'tshol ba'i srol dar zer/ da dung hor rgong ma chen pos pa zhes pa slob dpon gyi ming gsol/ chu lug (spyi lo 1283)lor dgongs pa rdzogs/ (2)g.ya' bzang dgon pa phyag btab/ (3)hor gyi yul dpon rnams o nan gtsang po'i 'gram du tshogs 'du 'tshogs/ jing gir hor yongasakyi dar han rtu bskos/ mong gol han rgyal khab btsugs/ de nas mong gol zhes sde khag gcig gi ming de hor yongs kyi spyi ming du gyur/spyi lo 1207/ me yos/ rab byung bzhi pa 'go tshugs/sbyi lo 1208/ sa 'drug (1)kha che paṇa chen shākya sri ra theng sogs su byon/ (2)kha che paṇa chen gyi drung du sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan bsnyen rdzogs mdzad/spyi lo 1210/ lcags rta/ stag lung thang pa bkra shis dpal dgongs pa rdzogs/spyi lo 1211/ lcags lug mong gol gyis ce'u rgyal rabs la bstad mar phar rgol byasi stabs ce'u rgyal rabs 'thor zhig 'gro ba'i gnas su lhung /sbyi lo 1214/ zhing khyi/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shri kha che'i yul du phyir log mdzad/sbyi lo 1217/ me glang / bka' brgyad pa'i bla ma mkhas can kun ldan ras pa sku gshegs/ cusbyi lo 1219/ sa yos/ jing gir rgyal pos dmag 'bum tsho gnyis 'khrid nas ho tshe tshe rma'o zhes pa'i rgyal phran der dmag drangs/sbyi lo 1225/ shing bya/ kha che paṇa chen shākya shri dgongs nga rdzoṭa/spyi lo 1227/ me phag tor jing gir rgyal po bde bar gshegs/23

spyi lo 1235/ zhing lug 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang rngog seng ge sgra sgrog sku bltams/spyi lo 1240/ lcags byi/ e chen go dan rgyal pos hor gyi dmag dpon chen po dor rta nag po sogs hor dmag khri 'ga' zhig bod du btang /bod gcig gyur bzo ba'i 'go brtsams/sbyi lo 1243/ chu yos/ kun spangs thugs rje brtson 'grus la stod byang du 'khrungs/ kun mkhyen chos sku 'od zer sogs bla mar bsten nas chos mang du gsan/ dus 'khor sbyor drug gi yi ge mdzad/ sung dang yon rgyal rabs kyi dus mtshams su gtsang rje nang dgon pa phyag btab/ byang sems rgyal ba'i ye shes sogs slob ma mang da byang / chu yos(1303)lor dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ ༄ ༄sbyi lo 1244/ shing 'drug hor go dan rgyal po'i bka' ltar/sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dang / tsha bo 'phags pa dang / phyag na sku 'khor dang bcas pa sa skya nas chibs kha bsgyur te hor yul du phebs/ lha sar 'byor skabs 'phags pa jo bo'i sku mdun du rab tu byung / mtshan du 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan zhes gsol/ de nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa dpon 'khor dang bcas pa thad kor leng kra'u la phebs pa dang / sa skya pazlo tas lam bar lugs gnyis kyi byed sgo rgya cher spel nas phebs lam du lo gnyis tsam 'gor 'gyangs byung /sbyi lo 1246/ me rta/ sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan leng kra'u du 'byor/ bod 'di mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs su dngos su sgyur rgyu'i skor la hor go dan rgyal po dang bka' gros legs par mdzad/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs khag dang mi dmangs la phan pa'i ched du bslab bya'i ri

sprengs yig btang / hor go dan rgyal pos sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan bod yongs kyi srid kyi byed po gtso bor bsko bzhag stsal/sbyi lo 1251/ lcags phag sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan bgrang bya bdun cu don gcig tu phebs te rlung kra'u la dgongs pa rdzogs/khong ni rig pa'i gnas lngar byang chub pa zhig yin stabs mtshan du'ang sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta zhes phyi nang kun tu grags che bar gyur/ lhag par du dgung lo drug cu lhag tsam du phebs zin pa'i rjes su dka' ngal gang la'ang ma 'dzems par bod mi dmangs kyi bsam 'dun ltar mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur yong ba'i ched du dngos su leng kro'u du phebs/ mi rigs khag gi mthun sgril dang mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur la phan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad/sbyi mo 1252/ chu byi/ hor dmag gis tā li rgyal khab la dpung 'jug byed skabs hor se chen rgyal pos dmag dpung 'bum gnyis tsam 'khrid nas bod la dmag lam byas/sbyi lo 1253/ chu glang / hor se chen rgyal po dang / 'gro mgon 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dbar thugs mi bden pa phran tsam byung yang /hor se chen rgyal po'i btsun mo de ni mkhyen rgya shin tu che bas bslab bya yang yang gnang bas hor se chen rgyal pos 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i drung nas dbang zhus/ ti sri ste gong ma'i slob dpon gyi mtshan gsol/sbyi lo 1254/ shing stag karma pa sku phreng gnyis pa mi pa hor gong ma'i drung du byon/ yon gong mas las zhwa nag po zhig gnang bas phyis rkarma bka' brgyad zhwa nag pa zhes grags/ da dung pagi ste slob dpon gyi mtshan gsol nadro gzengs su bstod/ sbyi lo 1260/ lhags sprel/ (1)'gro mgon 'phags pa blo ཿ6

spyi lo 1271/ lcags lug hor gyi rgyal rabs kyi ming bsgyur nas yon rgyal rabs zhes btags/sbyi lo 1274/ shing khyi/ (1)bal bod sa mtshams su thar pa gling btabs/ (2) 'gro mgon 'phags pa gtso 'khor rnams pe cing nas chibs kha bsgyur/ji lo 1276/ me byi/ (1) 'gro mgon 'phags pa ska 'khor rnams lam bar lo tsam 'gor te sa skyar 'byor/ (2)dpang lo blo gror+sha brtan pa 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1277/ me glang / (1)dpyid zla ra bar/ 'gro mgon 'phags pas dge 'dun khri phrag bdun lhag tsam la zhal zas gya nom pas bsnyen bkur dang / dge 'dun rer gser zho re'i 'gyed mdzad/ chos 'khor der gus pa'i dge 'dun khri phrag bdun dang / gzhan yang chos smra ba'i bshes gnyen gzhung lugs du ma'i pha rol du son pa stong phrag du ma/ skye bo phal pa dang bcas pa 'bum phrag la nye bar bsnyen bkur phun sum tshogs pa'i dus ston khyad par can chu mig chos 'khor du grags pa mdzad/ (2)kha cig tu ri bo che'i dgon pa btab zer/spyi lo 1281 / lcags sprul/ (1)'gro mgon 'phags pa sa skya lha khang chen mo'i nye 'gram 'phags pa'i pho brang du ska gshegs/ kha cig tu sa skya pa'i dbang 'dzin pa nang khul 'gal ba ches cher can te/ dpon rigs la las 'gro mgon 'phags pa'i mtshan 'khyer nas dpon chen kun dga' bzang pos gong ma dang 'gro mgon 'phags pa lhag bsam rnam dag med lugs dbyin sbyor mang tsam byas stabs/ de rdzun rkab rdol yong snyam nas 'gro mgon 'phags par dug btang nas bkrongs zer/ 6)yon gong ma'i dmag dpung sa skyar yong 27

nas dpon chen kun dga' bzang po bzung / dpon chen gyis yin min gyi gnas lugs rnams zhib gsal zhus kyang / gong ma'i dpon dmag gis dkar nag dbye ba ma phye bar bya rog rdzong du dpon chen kun dga' bzang po dmar gsod btang /sbyi lo 1283/ chu lug (1)karma pa ska 'phreng gnyis pa kurma pa'i dgongs pa rdzogs/ (2) rngog chos kyi rgyal mtshan rdong zhwa dmar ba rtogs ldan grags pa seng ge 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1284/ zhing sprel/ kurma pa rang byung rdo rje 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1288/ sa byi/ tsung kre yon zhes pa'i spyi khyab las khungs de zhon grin yon zhes ming bsgyur/ 'di ni yon gong ma se chen gyis bod 'di mes rgyal mnga' khongs su dngos su bsgyur rjes bod kyi phyi nang las don gal chen mtha' dag la bka' bkod byed pa'i srid 'dzin las khungs shig red/sbyi lo 1290/ lcags stag (1)'bri gung pas sa skya'i bka' bkod la mi nyan par ngo rgol byas stabs sa skya'i khri skor bcu gsum gyi dmag dpung gis 'bri gung bcom/ der lo rgyus thog 'bri gung gling log zer/ (2)bu ston rin po che sku bltams/ cispyi lo 1297/ me bya/ bdag nyid chen po sman rtser bzhugs skabs gong ma'i drung du gdan drangs/sbyi lo 1302/ chu stag tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dang lo chen byang chub rtse mo sku bltams/sbyi lo 1303/ chu yos/ (1)grub thob me long rdo rje gshegs/(2)karma pa rang byung rdo rjes lha steng btab/sbyi lo 1304/ shang sprul/ bdag chen nam mkha' legs dang gam 28

rkam rin chen song ge sku 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1306/ me rta/ bdag chen bzang po dpal sa skya'i gdan sar phebs/spyi lo 1308/ sa sprel/ (1)klong chen rab 'byams pa/ mtshan dngos dri med 'od zer sto kha grwa nang la 'khrungs/ rig 'dzin rmā ra dza sogs mdo sngags rig gnas mang du gsan/ gangs ri thod dkar du u rgyan rdzong gnas kyi dgon pa btab/ mdzod bdun sogs mdo sngags rig gnas kyi gsung rtsom mang du mdzad/ khong ni rnying ma ba'i mkhas grub grags can zhig yin/dgung lo nga drug 'tsho/ spyi lo 1363lor dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs/(2)rngog seng ge sgra gshegs/sbyi lo 1312 / chu byi/ sa skya'i bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1320/ lcags sprel/ u rgyan mgon pos ri bo che'i gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ji 'os 1322 / chu khyi/ (1)tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan la phag gru'i khri dpon bsko bzhag stsal/ (2)bu ston rin po ches bstan rtsis mdzad/sbyi r+shatswa 1326/ me stag (1)sto brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ (2)dus 'khor rtsa rgyud gsungs nas lo nyis stong nyis brgya dang bzhi 'das pa bu ston gyis gsungs/sbyi lo 1327/ me yos/ (1)rab byung drug pa 'go tshugs/ (2)sa skya nga kun blo dang kum kum rin chen gzhon nu gnyis dgongs pa rdzogs/spyi lo 1331 / sa byi/ rkarma pa rang byung rdo rje hor yul du byon/ji lo 1335/ shing phag karma pa rang byung rdo rjes mi nyag gi sbyal

du dgon sde khag la zhig gso mdzad/spyi lo 1335/ sa yos/ kurma pa rang byung rdo rje rgya nag tu dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 1348/ sa byi/ phag gru khri dpon dang tshal pa khri dpon dbar srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod shugs cher phyin nas phag rgyas tshal pa khri dpon la dmag drangs/ tshal pa'i sa cha dang 'bangs rnams phag gru'i lag tu shor/sbyi lo 1349/ sa glang / tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis dbus gtsang dbang du bskyar zhes bstan rtsis re'u mig tu gsungs/ sbyi lo 1350/༄lcags phag phag gru khri dpon gyis 'bri gung du dmag drangs te 'bri gung par pham nyes chen po byung / skabs der dbus kyi sa cha yongs rdzogs dang sa skya'i mnga' khongs sa cha khag gcig phag gru'i dbang du bsdas/sto spyi lo 1341 / lcags yos/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan gyis rtsed thang phyag btab/sbyi lo 1354/ thing rta/ (1)phag rgya'i dmag dpung sa skyar bskyod de zhi drag gi thabs rnam pa sna tshogs la brten nas dpon chen rgyal ba bzang po btson nas bton/ phag gru'i dmag dpung gis sa skya dgon pa'i mtha' bzhi bskor te dpon chen dbang phyug brtson 'grus gson por bzung / sa skya ba'i dpon dmag bzhi brgya lhag tsam bsad/ yon gong mas gnang ba'i gna' rdzas dang dngos rigs gal che ba 'bor chen 'phrog de nas bzung sa skya bas bod dbang bsgyur ba'i mjug bsgril/ (2)yon gong ma tho kun the'i mur gyis byang chub rgyal mtshan la tā si tu'i cho lo dang bod yongs kyi srid dbang 'dzin chog 30

pa'i bka' shog dang dam ga gnang /spyi lo 1357/ me bya/ rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa blo bzang grags pa shar tsong kha'i yul du sku 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1359/ sa phag (1)kha cig tu kurma pa rol pa'i rdo rje'i drung du tsong kha pa dge bsnyen mdzad zer/ (2)g.yag sde paṇa chen gyis e wam dgon pa phyag btab/ (3)rgo sri bsod nams grags pa 'khrungs/ lo chen byang chub rtse mo sogs bla mar bsten nas bsnyen par rdzogs/ spyi lo 1391lor sne'u gdong rtse'i khri la 'khod de lo lnga bzhugs/ 'di ni phag rgya'i sde srid bzhi pa yin zer/ ming gong ma chen pos kwa den gu sri ste rgyal khab slob dpon gtsug gi nor bu zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / dgung lo lnga bcu sa byi(1408)lor sku gshegs/sbyi lo 1362 / chu stag chos rje don grub rin chen gyis rje tsong kha pa la dbang bskur te gsang ba'i mtshan du don yod rdo rje zhes gsol/sbyi lo 1363/ chu yos/ rje tsong kha pa chen po dge tshul bsgrabs te mtshan du blo bzang grags pa zhes gsol/ cuspyi lo 1364/ shing 'drug (1)bu ston rin po che sku gshegs/(2)rgyal tshab rma rin chen gtsang nyang stod ri nang du 'khrungs/ khong thog mar sa skya pa'i lugs kyi mkhas pa zhig yin/ rjes su tsong kha pa gnyal stod ra grong du bzhugs pa dang mjal/ rje tsong kha pa'i thugs sras gtso bo gnyis kyi nang nas bgres pa zhig yin la khri pa lo 13mdzad/ mdo sngags kyi gsung rtsom pod brgyad brtsams/ chu byi(spyi lo 1432)lor gzim khri mtha' can du gyur/ (3)tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dgung lo 63la phebs te dgongs pa rdzogs/'di ni sku chung ngu'i dus su sa skyar yun ring bzhugs/ rig gnas spyi dang khyad 31

par du dmag don skor sbyangs pa mthar phyin gnang / dmag srid kyi bya ba shin tu mkhas par gyur/ de rjes phag gru'i khri dpon mdzad/ tshal pa dang / 'bri gung / g.ya' bzang sogs khri dpon khag la dmag drangs/ thog mar dbus kyi sa cha rnams kha lo bsgyur/ de nas rim bzhin gtsang phyogs sa skya pa'i mnga' 'og mang po dbang du bsdas/ mthar sa skya'i srid dbang mgo rting bslogs/bod yongs chab srid kyi jobang cha bzung / yon gong ma chen pos tā si tu dang bod kyi srid dbang 'dzin chog pa'i bka' shog dang tham kha sogs gnang /sbyi lo 1368/ sa sprel/ yon gong ma rgyal sa shor nas hor yul du bros phyin/ kru'u yon krang gis nan cing rgyal sa bzung ste ming rgyal rabs dngos su btsugs/ sde srid phag gru dang bod kyi dpon chen bla chen khag nas ched mngags pho nya btang ste ming gong ma chen po kru'u yon krang khrir 'khod par rten 'brel zhus/ji lo 1372/ chu byi/ ming gong ma chen pos bod du dbus gtsang zhing tu'u kre hud gyi si zhes pa'i spyi khyab bkod 'doms las khungs btsugs/sbyi lo 1375/ ging yos/ (1)bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dgongs pa rdzogs/ (2)bo dong phyogs las rnam rgyal dang zhwa lu ba leṭa pa rgyal mtshan sku 'khrungs/spyi lo 1378/ sa rta/ g.yag sde paṇa chen gshegs/sbyi lo 1381 / lcags bya/ tā si tu byang chub rgyal mtshan dang yab gcig pa'i gcung bsod nams grags pa gser khrir mnga' gsol/sbyi lo 1383/ chu phag karma pa rol pa'i rdo rje gshegs/sbyi lo 1384/ shing byi/ (1)karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa 'khrungs/ de'i chos ming du chos dpal bzang po zhes zer/ kum pa'i sku phreng 32

lnga pa yin pa dang 'khrungs yul ni kong po rgya mda' rdzong khongs myang 'dam yin/ming rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyas nang g.yung lo khri lo lnga pa'i dpyid gar ming gong ma'i bka' ltar nan cing du 'ongs nas chos kyi bya ba rgya cher spel bar brten chos rje rin po che de bzhin gshegs pa zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/ g.yang ṭi'i dam kha stsal/ spyi lo 1416la dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ (2)stag lung dgon pa'i mchod khang dmar po bzhengs/sbyi lo 1385/ shing glang / (1)mi yi dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan gser khrir mnga' gsol/ (2)grub thob thang stong rgyal po mtshan dngos khro bo dpal ldan nam brtson 'grus bzang po zer/ 'di ni gtsang stod 'ol pa lha rtser 'khrungs/ sman dang bzo rig pa sogs la shin tu mkhas pa zhig yin/des kong po'i yul nas lcags rdo bton/ bod rigs sa khongs su lcags zam lnga bcu nga brgyad dang gru shan rta mgo brgya dang bco brgyad/ shing zam drug cu tsam btsugs pas la la da lta'ang dngos su mthong rgyu yod/ bod kyi lha mo gong spel btang ste a sne lha mo 'khrab pa'i srol gtod stabs lha mo ba rnams kyis dran gso zhu ba'i ched du 'khrub ston byed skabs thang stong rgyal po'i 'dra sku zhig 'khyer srol yod/ dgung lo brgya dang nyer lnga 'tsho/ spyi lo 1509la gtsang ri bo cher gshegs/sbyi lo 1386/ me stag chos rje bsod nams grags pa phag gru'i gdan sar phebs/sbyi lo 1387/ me yos/ rab byung bdun pa 'go tshugs/sbyi lo 1388/ sa 'drug ming gong ma chen pos phag gru grags pa rgyal mtshan la hang 'us wang zhes pa'i rgyal po'i cho lo dang / kwa ting go sri ste rgyal khab slob rdopon gtsug gi nor bu zhes pa'i 'ja' sa dang / gser gyi dam 33

kha bcas gnang / de nas bzung wang grags pa rgyal mtshan zhes kun la grags che bar gyur/spyi lo 1390/ lcags rta/ mkhan chen 'jam dpal ye shes dang /'brug pa blo gros seng ge 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1391 / lcags lug tā la'i sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub pa gtsang shab stod ngar 'tshor sku 'khrungs/spyi lo 1391 / chu sprel/ yid bzang rtse ba gzhon nu dpal lam 'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal rgya sman du 'khrungs/ rje tsong kha pa dang rgya gar gyi mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te sbyang pa mthar phyin mdzad/ mdo sngags kyi gzhung don dang / rig gnas sogs la shin tu mkhas par gyur te deb sngon sogs bstan bcos du ma brtsams/ spyi lo 1481 lor sku gshegs/spyi lo 1399/ sa yos/ mkhan chen bsod nams mchog grub 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1400/ lcags 'drug paṇa chen byams pa gling pa 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1401 / lcags sprul/ lho brag nam mkha' rgyal mtshan mdze nad phog ste 'das/ 'di'i sku gdung dga' ldan dgon pa'i shar ngos su sbas te der mchod rten zhig btab/ gyis sto brag bum pa zhes gnas khyad par can du gyur/ sbyi lo 1407/ me phag chos rje mkhas grub dang rje tsong kha pa chen po zhal mjal/spyi lo 1408/ sa byi/ ming gong ma chen pos bka' zhog btang ste snyigs dus rgyal ba gnyis pa mes rgyal nang khul du gdan drangs kyang cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i sta gon dang mi dug phog pa'i snyung gzhi sogs yod stabs 34

phebs mi thub par sku tshab tu byams chen chos rje phebs/sbyi lo 1409/ sa glang / (1)rje tsong kha pa chen pos lha ldan cho'aphrul smon lam chen mo btsugs/ (2)tsong kha pa'i gdan sa ri bo dga' ldan rnam par dag pa'i gling phyag btab/ de snga gnas 'dir bon gyi dgon pa zhig yod skad/ (3)gong ma chen po yung los wang grags pa rgyal mtshan la hran ha wang gi cho lo dang shel gyi dam kha stsal/sbyi lo 1413/ chu sprul/ ming gong ma chen pos slar yang tsong kha par gdan zhu'i gser yig btang / ska khams bde min gyis phebs mi thub par dgong zhu btang / d+kuspyi lo 1415/ shing lug karma pa de bzhin gshegs pa dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/spyi lo 1416/ me sprel/ (1) rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma 'jam dbyangs chos rjes dpal ldan 'bras spungs phyag btab/ (2) ming gong ma yung los rin spungs pa nam mkha' rgyal por dpa' ngar can gyi dmag dpon zhes pa'i ming gnang / (3) karma pa mthong ba don ldan sku bltams/sbyi lo 1419/ me sprel/ rje tsong kha pa'i slob ma byams chen chos rjes se ra theg chen gling phyag btab/spyi lo 1429/ sa bya/ ngor dgon pa btab/spyi lo 1432/ chu byi/ (1) wang grags pa rgyal mtshan dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ phag gru'i gdung rgyud nang khul mi mthun par srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod langs/ (2) rgyal tshab chos rje dar ma rin chen gshegs/ (3)dge 'dun grub kyis rnam 'grel ṭīka brtsams/spyi lo 1433/ chu glang / phag gru'i gdung sras grags pa 'byung 35

gnas mi 'jigs gser gyi khrir mnga' gsol/spyi lo 1434/ shing stag sras grags pa 'byung gnas dang de'i yab sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan bar srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod langs/ der lo rgyas thog stag lo sde gzar chen po zhes grags/sbyi lo 1135/ zhing yos/ rin spungs pa don grub rdo rjes dmag drangs nas gzhis ka bsam 'grub rtse blangs/sbyi lo 1437/ me sprul/ rje tsong kha pa'i dngos slob byang sems chos rje shes rab bzang pos chab mdo dgon byams pa gling phyag btab/sbyi lo 1440/ lcags sprel/ ming gong ma chen pos phag gru'i gdung rgyud grags pa 'byung gnas la wang ste rgyal po'i cho lo bstsal bas mtshan snyan ches cher 'phel/spyi lo 1444/ zhing byi/ (1)sras wang grags pa 'byung gnas dgongs pa rdzogs/ phag gru'i srid dbang yab sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis bzung / (2)kha cig tu chab mdo dgon byams pa gling phyag btab par 'dod/sbyi lo 1445/ zhing glang / sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan gyis phag rgya'i srid dbang kho pa'i sras chung ba kun dga' legs su sprad/ ming gong ma sha'an tsung gis kun dga' legs la hran ha wang zhes pa rgyal po'i cho lo bstsal/sbyi lo 1447/ me yos/ (1)rab byung brgyad pa 'go tshugs/(2)tā la sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub pas gtsang bkra shis lhan po'i dgon pa phyag btab/ (3)hor ston nam mkha' dpal gshegs/ cusbyi lo 1449/ sa sprul/ rdo ring ba kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma 'khrungs/mi

sbyi lo 1450/ lcags rta/ rje dge 'dun grub pa dga' ldan gyi khrir gdan drangs kyang ma phebs/sbyi lo 1451 / lcags lug steng chen dgon pa phyag btab/spyi lo 1453/ chu bya/ rkarma pa mthong ba don ldan gshegs/ji lo 1454/ zhing khyi/ (1)kun dga' legs kyi sras chos rje rin po che dpal ngag gi dbang pos phag gru'i srid dbang bzung / (2)karma pa chos grags rgya mtsho dang sgam po ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ (3)spyan snga rdo rje rgyal mtshan g.ya' bzang gi gdan sar phebs/sbyi lo 1456/ me byi/ rkarma pa 'phrin las pa 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1463/ chu lug bkra shis lhan por byams chen grub/sbyi lo 1469/ sa glang / rje joge 'dun grub pas 'dul ṭikā rin chen phreng ba brtsams/spyi lo 1472/ chu 'drug bstan rtsis re'u mig ltar na/ rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa bgrang bya brgyad cu gya gnyis phebs te bkra shis lhan por sku gshegs/ kha cig tu shing rta(1474)lor sku gshegs zer/ cusbyi lo 1476/ me sprel/ (1)tā la sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho gtsang rta nag tu sku bltams/ (2)kha cig tu 'gos lo tsā bas deb sngon brtsams zer/sbyi lo 1474/ sa khyi/ (1)paṇa chen lung rigs rgya mtsho bkra shis lhan po'i gdan sar phebs/ (2)'gos lo tsā ba gzhon nu dpal gyis deb sgor sngon po brtsams/ 'di ni bod kyi lo rgyas zhib 'jug la mkho ba'i deb ther gal che ba'i gras shig yin/ cusbyi lo 1479/ sa phag 'bri gung khru pa kha'i dgon pa btab/37

sbyi lo 1480/ lcags byi/ rin spungs pa don yod rdo rjes dmas khri gcig lhag tsam 'khrid de sne'u rdzong sogs rdzong gzhis 'ga' zhig btsan bzung byas/ dus der gtsang khul gyi rdzong gzhis mang che ba rin spungs pa'i dbang du 'dus/ji lo 1493/ chu glang / ming gong ma chen pos gser yig pa mngags te spyan snga ngag gi dbang por wang zhes pa rgyal po'i cho lo dang gnang sbyin gnang / spyan snga rin po che dgongs pa rdzogs zin stabs gnang sbyin rnams phyag mdzod la gsol ras bstsal nas gong ma'i pho nya phyir logaspyi lo 1494/ ging stag (1)ye shes rtse mos rgyal ba dge 'dun grub pa'i rnam thar brtsams/ (2)sa chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis bka' gdams chos 'byung brtsams/spyi lo 1499/ sa lug rlangs kyi gdung rgyud bkra shis grags pa gser khrir mnga' gsol/ ming gong ma chen pos sngar srol ltar kwa ting go shri phe wang ste rgyal khab slob dpon gtsug gi nor bu chos kyi rgyal po zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / dus der phag gru'i srid dbang don dngos thog tu rin spungs pas bzung /spyi lo 1503/ chu phag zhwa dmar ba bzhi pas yangs pa can gyi dgon pa dang lha sar thub bstan chos 'khor btab/spyi lo 1504/ shing byi/ dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng ba 'khrungs/byi lo 1505/ zhing glang / rgyal ba blo bzang don grub dang mkhan chen blo gros phyogs las rnam rgyal 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1507/ me yos/ (1)rab byung dgu pa 'go tshugs/ (2)ga pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang 'phags pa sangs rgyus 'khyungs/snye

thi lo 1509/ sa sprul/ tā la ska phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos dgas stod rgyal gyi lha mo'i bla mtsho'i nye 'jom du chos 'khor rgyal dgon pa btab/spyi lo 1512/ chu sprel/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtsho bkra shis lhan po'i gdan sar phebs/ d+kuspyi lo 1517/ me glang / tā la dge 'dun rgya mtshos dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon pa'i mkhan po mdzad/sbyi lo 1518/ sa stag tā la dge 'dun rgya mtshos lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshogs dbu mdzad/sbyi lo 1525/ zhing bya/ rgyal ba dge 'dun rgya mtshos se ra theg chen gling gi mkhan po mdzad/ sbyi lo 1527/ me phag (1)zhwa lu lo chen bde bar gshegs/(2)'brug pad+ma dkar po 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1531 / lcags yos/ 'phags pa sangs rgyas kyis nyang por bkra shis phan bde'i dgon pa btab/sbyi lo 1541 / lcags glang / mnga' ris grwa tshang btsugs/sbyi lo 1542 / chu stag (1)zla 3tshes 8nyin/ tā la ska phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho dpal ldan 'bras spungs dga' ldan pho brardzu du dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ (2)yar stod dga' tshal btab/sbyi lo 1543/ chu yos/ tā la sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho stod lung rtse dga' khang gsar gong du sku bltams/sbyi lo 1546/ me rta/ (1)tshal gung thang dgon par me skyon byung / (2)tā la skyu phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgyu mtsho 'bras bangs su gdan su

drangs/sbyi lo 1548/ sa sprel/ rje shes rab dbang pos khams dar rgyas dgon pa phyag btab/khyu lo 1549/ sa bya/ (1)tā la sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho rab tu byung / (2)gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling btab/sbyi lo 1550/ lcags khyi/ ba so sprul skus khams bshad sgrub gling phyag btab/spyi lo 1554/ zhing stag karma pa mi bskyod rdo rje dang paṇa chen bsod nams grags pa dgongs pa rdzogs/spyi lo 1556/ me 'drug karma pa dbang phyugs rdo rje 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1565/ zhing glang / rin spungs pa'i mnga' zhabs zhing shag pa tshe brtan rdo rje gtsang yul gyi dpon rigs 'ga' zhig dang mna' sbrel byas te rin spungs pa'i srid dbang mgo rting bslogs/sbyi lo 1567/ me yos/ rab byung bcu pa 'go tshugs/sbyi lo 1570/ lcags rta/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1571 / lcags lug stag lung ngag dbang rnam rgya' sku bltams/sbyi lo 1574/ zhing khri/ si tu kurma chos kyi rgyal mtshan 'khrungs/ji lo 1577/ me blang / (1)tā la sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho sog yul du byon zer/ (2)sku 'bum byams pa gling btab/gyi lo 1578/ sa stag tā la sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya

mtsho mchog sog po al thal gser gyi rgyal pos sog yul du spyan drangs/ tā la'i bla ma zhes rgya mtsho bla ma zhes pa'i bstod pa'i mtshan phul/ 'on kyang tā la'i bla ma zhes pa'i bstod pa'i mtshan de tā la sku phreng lnga pa nas khyab gdal che bar grags/ spyo lo 1579/ sa yos/ tā la bsod nams rgya mtsho dang al thal gser gyi rgyal pos byang chen chos 'khor gling btab/spyi lo 1580/ lcags 'drug bsod nams ye dbang gis spom 'bor gyi li thang thub chen chos 'khor gling btab/sbyi lo 1581 / lcags sprul/ tā la sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho chab mdo'i khrir phebs zhes bstan rtsis re'u mig tu gsal/sbyi lo 1582/ chu rta/ go shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal sku bltams/de ni a mdo khul gyi sog rigs tsho pa ho shod kyi 'go dpon zhig yin/ spyi lo 1642la bod la dmag dpung btang / gtsang pa sde srid kurma bstan skyong dbang po'i srid dbang mgo rting bslogs nas dbus gtsang mdo smad sogs kyi srid dbang tā la lnga par phul/sbyi lo 1588/ sa byi/ tā la sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho dgung lo zhe bdun la phebs te sog yul du dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 1589/ sa thang / zla 1tshes 1nyin tā la sku phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho mkhar sngon por sku bltams/spyi lo 1594/ shing rta/ go sri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis mgo dkar bcom/sbyi lo 1603/ chu yos/ tā la sku phreng bzhi pa yon tan rgya mtsho dbus su gdan drangs/41

bstan skyong dbang po'i dmag dpung dang g.yul 'gyed/ mthar pham nas ser 'bras kyi grwa pa mang che ba yul phyogs gzhan la bros byol du 'gro dgos byung yong ro 'dir phag gru'i srid dbang dngos su mgo rting bslogs nas kurma pa'i sreng dbang btsugs/ sbyi lo 1619/ sa lug phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan gyis tā la ska phreng gong ma'i sku chas len par 'gro bar kha g.yar nas go shri han la dmag ༄rogs bcol par bskyod/sbyi lo 1620/ lcags sprel/ kurma bstan skyong dbang pos bod yongs kyi srid dbang bdag gir bzung /spyi lo 1621 / lcags bya/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan dang sog po lha btsun blo bzang bstan 'dzin sogs dpon dmag nyis stong lhag tsam lha sar 'byor/ rkyang thang sgang du gtsang dmag dang g.yul 'gyed/ gtsang dmag rnams pham ste lcog po rir bros/spyi lo 1627/ me yos/ rab byung bcu gcig pa 'go tshugs/sbyi lo 1637/ shing khyi/ phyag mdzod bsod nams rab brtan nam bsod nams chos 'phel sogs nas skog tu pho nya mngags te slar yang go sri han la dmag rogs bcol/sbyi lo 1635/ shing phag gtsang pa rgyal po kurma bstan skyong dbang po'i re 'dun la gzhigs te cha har len tan rgyal po'i bu ar sa lang gis dmag mi khri gcig khrid nas bod du 'ongs/sbyi lo 1636/ ma byi/ ar sa lang lam bar blo log ste pha yi bka' la ma brtsis par kurma bstan skyong dbang por rgyab skyor byed rgyu lta zhogagatsang dmag dang g.yul 'thab pas cha har len tan rgyal po'i bka' bkod ma

ltar ar sa lang dang lag rogs dmag dpon gsum skog tu bgrongs/sbyi lo 1637/ me glang / go sri han dpung dmag 'khor dang bcas pa dbus su 'byor/ rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos bsu ba dang sne len gzab rgyas gnang ba dang 'brel go sri bstan 'dzin chos kyi rgyal po zhes bstod pa'i mtshan dang dam kha phul/sbyi 44 1639/ sa yos/ zla 6par rgo shri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis thog mar rkarma bstan skyong dbang po'i dpung rogs be ri sa 'go don grub rdo rje tshar bcad/spyi lo 1642/ sa rta/ go sri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyis thog mar mdo khams bzung / rim bzhin gtsang pa sde srid rjes 'brangs pa dang bcas pa cham la phab/ bod kyi srid dbang rgyal mchog lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshor phul/ gnam bskos dga' ldan pho brang gi srid dbang dngos su btsugs/sbyi lo 1643/ chu lug rgyal mchog lnga pa chen pos deb ther dpyid kyi rgyal mo'i glu dbyangs brtsams/sbyi lo 1644/ zhing sprel/ li tse drang gi dmag dpung pe cing da 'byor/ ming rgyal rabs kyi gong ma khyung gran ti bros ma thar bar cin hran the bo'i steng du rang srog lcebs/ de nas ming rgyal rabs 'thor zhig tu phyin/chin rgyal rabs dngos su btsugs/ man ju'i sku drag nyung shas dang / sa bdag gral rim thun mong thog krung go yongs su dbang bsgyur/sbyi lo 1645/ shing bya/ (1)zla 4tshes 1 nyin rtse pho brang dkar po'i ming gzhi bting / (2) pha bong kha'i rnam thar brtsams/sbyi lo 1648/ sa byi/ (1)rtse pho brang dkar po legs par bsgrubs/ (2)chin gong ma chen po shun tses tā la sku phreng lnga pa pe cing snye

gser gyi pho brang du gdan drangs pa'i mi sna btang /sbyi lo 1652/ chu 'drug 2tshes 15nyin 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bka' ltar/ rgyal dbang lnga pa blo bzang rgya mtsho dang chibs zhabs gsol gzim zhabs 'bring / bod sog dpon rigs dang bcas pa dpal ldan 'bras spungs nas chibs kha bsgyur te mes rgyal rgyal sa pe cing du phebs/gong ma chen pos bsu ba zhabs tog gang legs gnang ba ma zad/ gser gyi byang bu bco lnga 'phrul mig tu sbrel te ltebs chog pa zhig gi thog nub kyi lha gnas ches dge bar bde bar gnas pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bka' lung / gnam 'og gi skye 'gro thams cad bstan pa gcig tu gyur pa 'gyur med 'chang rgya mtsho'i bla ma zhes rgya bod hor gsum gyi yi ge shan sbyar 'khod pa'i 'ja' sa sogs bstsal/sbyi lo 1653/ chu sprul/ (1)zla 3tshes 10nyin tā la ska phreng lnga pa pe cing nas chibs kha bsgyur te ta'i khar zhes pa'i sa gnas su 'byore skabs 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos pho nya ched du mngags te gser yig dang / tham ga skad rigs bzhi'i yi ge shan sbyar ba'i 'bru don du/ nub phyogs kyi phul byung zhi ba sangs rgyas rgya chen khyon la sangs rgyas bstan pa mnga' bdag thams cad mkhyen pa rdo rje 'chang tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga zhes 'khod pa zhig gnang / dga' ldan lnga mchod skabs tā la'i zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa lha sar 'byor/ (2)rig gnas spyi dang khyad par sman rtsis mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho 'khrungs/spyi lo 1654/ shing rta/ (1)zla 12tshes 17nyin go shri bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho bgrang bya bdun cu don gsum la phebs te dgongs pa rdzogs/(2)sras bstan 'dzin rdo rjer gong ma chen pos bstan 'dzin dar yan rgyal 45

po dkon mchog dā la'i nyan khrir bskos/sbyi lo 1669/ sa bya/ zla 8tshes 1 nyin mchod dpon blo bzang mthu stobs sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol/ des khri lo drug bskyangs/de'i dus su 'brug pas bod la dpung 'jug thengs gnyis tsam byas/ mthar pham nyes tshabs chen phog ste phyir logasbyi lo 1670/ lcags khyi/ tā la lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes kyis gsan yig gaṅga'i chu rgyun mdzad/spyi lo 1672/ chu byi/ rgyal ba lnga pa chen pos ri thang mtshams kyi nad brgya 'joms pa'i sman gcig brtsams/sbyi lo 1674/ shing stag (1)zla 3pa'i nang sa skya'i bdag mo bkra shis lags kyi gleng brjong la brten sde srid blo bzang mthu stobs khri nas phabs te gong dkar du 'jog gnang mdzad/ ser 'bras dang drung spyi bcas kyis zhu 'bul lan mang gnang ba'i ngor sde srid zur pa'i go gnas dang / ska skal du zangs ri bstsal te zangs rir bzhugs stabs phyis sde srid zangs ri cu bar grags/ (2)karma pa chos dbyings rdo rje bde bar gshegs/sbyi lo 1675/ shing yos/ (1)sangs rgyas rgya mtshor sde srid bsko bzhag bstsal yang ska na chung ba'i stabs kyis sde srid las 'gan bsgrab mi thub ces dgongs zhu gsheng / (2)zla 8tshes 24nyin blo bzang sbyin༄ pa rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi gnyer pa'i thog nas sde srid bsko bzhag bstsal/ phyis su sde srid sne gdong pa'ang zer/ khri lo lnga bskyangs/spyi lo 1679/ sa lug (1)zla 6par sde srid blo bzang sbyin pa dgongs pa zhus te sku skal du sne gdong bstsal ba dang / sde srid zur pa'i go gnas gnang ste dga' ldan khang gsar du bzhugs/ (2)zla 6tshes 6nyin ༈

mkhas dbang grong smad pa sangs rgyas rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol/ 'di ni lugs gnyis kyi bya bar mchog tu mnga' brnyes pa zhig yod pas khrir 'khod ma thag tu go sri'i gdung rgyud dang 'gal ba ches cher phyin/ khri lo nyer bdun bskyangs/ (3)'phags pa rgyal ba rgya mtsho dbus su byon/spyi lo 1681 / lcags bya/ rgyal po dga' ldan tshe dbang dpal bzang gis stod mnga' ris bskor gsum dbang du bsdus nas tā la lnga pa chen po'i 'bangs su phul/spyi lo 1682/ chu khyi/ zla 3tshes 15nyin rgyal ba lnga pa chen po bgrang bya drug cu re drug la phebs te rtse pho brang du gzim khri mtha' can du gyur/ gong ma mchog gi zhal chems ltar gsang rgya mdzad/spyi lo 1683/ chu phag tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho mon la 'og yul gsum du sku 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1686/ me stag pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho 'khrungs/sbyi lo 1687/ me yos/ (1)rab byung bcu gnyis pa 'go tshugs/ (2)sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos rtsis dpe be+e ḍūr+ya dkar po brtsams/spyi lo 1688/ sa 'drug mkhas dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtshos sman gzhung be+eḍūr+ya sngon po brtsams/sbyi lo 1696/ me byi/ zla 5tshes 10nyin rgyal dbang lnga pa ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang / yang srid 'khrul med tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho dgung lo 13la phebs pa'i skor khyab bsgrags mdzad/sbyi lo 1697/ me glang / (1)zla 10tshes 15nyin tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho pho brang chen po po tā lar gdan drangs te mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir 48

mnga' gsol/ (2) go sri'i gdung brgyud dkon mchog da la'i han tshe 'phen pa rdzogs/ de'i bu lha bzang han khrir bskos/ 'di ni khengs dregs ldan pa dang / gdug rtsub che ba/ gzu lum can zhig yod pas khrir 'khod ma thag tu bod sog dbang 'dzin pa dbar gyi 'brel ba nyin bzhin je sdug tu gyur/(3)tā la drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho rab tu byung /sbyi lo 1703/ chu lug (1) lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo'i skabs su lha bzang han gyi bkod mngags ltar/ kho pa'i rjes 'brangs pa la las sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i zhabs 'bring 'ga' zhig dmar gsod btang bar brten bod sog bar dmag 'khrug shugs chen langs/ ser 'bras dga' gsum dang 'jam dbyangs bzhad pas 'dum 'grigs mdzad/ (2)sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho khri las babs te gong dkar du bzhugs/ de'i sras ngag dbang rin chen sde srid du bskos/ rtsa ba'i 'gan dbang yongs rdzogs sangs rgyas rgya mtsho rang nyid nas mdzad skad/sbyi lo 1705 / shing bya/ sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho dang lha bzang bar srid dbang 'phrog res byed pa'i 'thab rtsod dza drag ches cher phyin te dmag 'thab langs/ zla catshes 29nyin lha bzang han gyi g.yo sgyu'i sbyor bas sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho stod lung snang rtser mgul bcad de bkrongs/ dbu stod lung gi chu la bskyur nas khri zam 'og nyin 'ga' zhig lus skad/ de nas lha bzang nyan gyis bod kyi srid dbang bdag gir bzung ba'i ched du sras sde srid ngag dbang rin chen 'dzin bzung byas te bgrongs dgos bsams kyang khong snga sa nas 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen por bde sdug zhu bar mes rgyal nang khul du phebs/sbyi lo 1706/ me khyi/ (1)lha bzang han gyi bu ngag dbang ye 49

shes rgya mtsho tā la'i yang srid yin khul gyis gser khrir mnga' gsol/(2)zla 6tshes 1nyin tā la drug pa tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho gser khri las phabs te lha klu dga' tshal du bzhag de rjes mes rgyal nang khul du khrid pa'i lam bar nas thar te mdo smad khul dang / zi khron/ dwags po/ sto kha/ lha sa/ mtsho sngon sogs sa gnas mang por phebs/ mtshan basbyar nas dgas po bla ma zhes 'bod/ yul gru khag la phebs skabs dka' dungang bsam las 'das pa spyad/spyi tshogs kyi myong bya phun sum tshogs pa byung bas go bde la tshig snyan pa dang dpe don mtshungs pa'i snyan tshig du ma brtsams/ mthar dgung lo drug cu lhag tsam 'tsho bzhugs thog mtsho sngon gyi nye 'gram du dgongs pa rdzogs zer/sbyi lo 1708/ sa byi/ tā la bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho li thang du sku bltams/ 'on kyang lha bzang han dbang shugs che bas re zhig ngos 'dzin zhu ma nus/ dus der mtsho sngon gyi dpon rigs 'ga' zhig gis yang srid rin po che gzhan lag tu shor dogs kyis mtsho mkhar gdan drangs/ de nas sku 'bum chos sder bzhugs/ spyi lo 1715/ shing lug bod 'brug sa mtshams skor 'khrug gzhi byung bas sa skya bdag chen dang / paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa blo bzang ye shes kyis bar 'dum mdzad/spyi lo 1717/ me bya/ (1)zla 11tshes 1nyin sog po jun gar ba'i dbung tshogs lha sar 'byor te/ lha bzang han dang dmag 'thab/ mthar lha bzang han dmag pham te zhol gyi shar sgo'i 'gram du dmar gsod btang /de nas bzung go sri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyad tshos bod du 'dzin pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha mjug bsgril (2)byen gar hong thas jis bod du bkod lung bsgyur te lo na mtho ba'i stag rtse lha rgyal rab brtan nam skyid skad 60

dga' ldan thas ji srid skyong gi khrir bskos/ (3)lha bzang han gyi bu pad dkar 'dzin pa ngag dbang ye shes khri las phabs te lcog po rir bcugaspyi lo 1718/ sa khyi/ gong ma khang shi'i dmag dpung bod du jun gar ba 'dul bar 'ongs/ nag chur dmag 'thab byas pas gong sku'i dmag dpung la pham nyes tshabs chen byung /sbyi lo 1719 / sa phag (1)gong ma'i dmag dpung thengs gnyis pa btang bas jun gar ba'i dmag dpung mnga' ris brgyad de bros/lam bar dmag 'thab byas pas pham nyes tshabs chen byung / cu (2)klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang chab mdo'i nye 'dabs dngul phur 'khrungs/ des tā la'i bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang / paṇa chen ska phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes sogs bsten/ khong gi slob ma grags carno ni 'jam dbyangs bzhad pa 'jigs med dbang po sogs yin/ de ni rig pa'i gnas la mkhas shing /gsung rtsom sna tshogs pod gcig yod/ spyi lo 1795lor bde bar gshegs/(3)brag g.yab che tshang la gong mas ho thog thu no min han gyi 'ja' sa dang gser tham gnang /spyi lo 1720/ lcags byi/ (1)jun gar ba'i dmag dpung yongs rdzogs bod nas mthar bskrad/ re zhig yul lung bde zhing zhi bar gnas/ (2)gong ma'i dmag dpung gis sde srid stag rtse ba lha rgyal rab brtan sogs lha sa'i skyid chu'i khar ske bcad de bkrongs/ (3)zla 4tshes 22nyin tā la bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho zi ling ska 'bum nas bod du thon skabs chin gong ma chen po'i bka' bzhin lha sras ༄cang jun gyis tā la'i bla ma bskal bzang rgya mtshor gser gyi bka' yig dang / gnang skyes bstsal ba ma zad/ lha sras cang jun dpung tshogs dang bcas pas 'bri chu'i bar phebs skyel 51

mdzad/ de nas lha sras phyir log dmag dpung byings rnams lha sa bar phebs skyel du bcar/ (4)zla 9tshes 15nyin rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho pho brang po tā lar mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir mnga' gsol/ 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos gser yig dang gser dam bstsal/ (6)gong ma'i cang jun dang / gung tshe dbang nor bu/ don grub wang / bstan 'dzin wang ngam blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ i sil mi li/ nga phod rdo rje rgyal po/ gung lum pa bkra shis rgyal po sogs rgya bod tshogs 'du chen pos lo gcig ring bod kyi srid bskyangs/spyi lo 1721 / lcags glang / da'i cing sba dur bsod nams rgyal po dang pa'i si nga phod pa rdo rje rgyal po/ gung lum pa bkra shis rgyal po/pho lha bas ji bsod nams stobs rgyal/ sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal po bcas nas srid bzung / khri lo bdun bskyangs/spyi lo 1722/ chu stag 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po khang shi'i dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs/sbyi lo 1723/ chu yos/ (1)yung gran gong ma'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/ (2)go sri bstan 'dzin chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud chin wang blo bzang bstan 'dzin gyis chin gong mar ngo log gong ma'i dmag dpung gis zing 'khrug snying 'jags su btang /sbyi lo 1727/ sa lug 9tshes 18nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi gzhung sgo'i thog kha'i tshoms chen khams gsum du nga lum sbyar gsum gyis da'i cing sba dur bsod nams rgyal por ral gri bsnan te bkrongs/ de nas btsun mo rgan gzhon gnyis dang zhabs 'bring gtso bo snams kyang dmar gsod btang /62

sbyi lo 1728/ sa sprel/ (1)lo mjug tu pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal dang gong ma'i dmag dpung gis nga phod rdo rje rgyal po dang /gung lum pa bkra shis rgyal po/ sbyar ra ba blo gros rgyal po sogs khrims la sbyar te dmar gsod btang / (2)rgyal yab dang nga lum sbyar gsum 'brel ba che bas gong ma chen po'i bka' bzhin rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho dang rgyal yab bsod nams dar rgyas dkar mdzes khul mgar thar du chibs kha bsgyur/ der lo bdun bzhugs/ (3)gong ma chen pos pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal la spa si'i cho lo dang / jun wang zhes pa'i 'ja' sa/ gser tham chen mo yi ge gsum sbyar 'bru don du dbus gtsang gi bka' slob kyi bya ba byed mkhan rdo ros spa si'i tham ga zhes pa bcas stsal te bod kyi chab srid byed po gtso bor bskos/sbyi lo 1730/ lcags khyi/ bod 'brug bar dmag 'khrug langs/bod dmag gis 'brug yul du dmag drangs/spyi lo 1735/ shing yos/ (1)zla 3tshes 21nyin 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos h+phu tu'u thung h+phu hra'u sogs dpon dmag lnga brgya tsam sku srung du btang ste tā la bskal bzang rgya mtsho bod du gdan drangs/ zla 7ches 17nyin lha ldan po tā lar phyag phebs/ (2)gong ma yung gran bde bar gshegs/de'i sras bzhi pa chan lung mi 'jigs gser gyi khri la mnga' gsol/sbyi zusgo 1737/ me spru'i / rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtsho gzhis rtser paṇa chen blo bzang ye shes mjal bar phebs/ de nas zla shas song mtshams paṇa chen dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ byi lo 1738/ sa rta/ zla 11tshes 11nyin paṇa chen drug pa dpal ldan ye shes sku bltams/53

khyu lo 1739/ sa lug gong ma chan lung gis pho lha bar tho lo jun wang gi cho lo dang / der sras gnyis yod pas sras rgan pa 'gyar med tshe brtan la mnga' ris gu gi cho lo gnang ste mnga' ris bskor gsum rū byed por bskos/ gzhon pa 'gyar med rnam rgyal la thas ji rim pa dang po'i cho lo gnang nas 'dam brgya shog (rgyad dang tsho pa so dgu'i 'go 'dzin mdzad/sbyi lo 1747/ me yos/ (1)rab byang bcu gsum pa 'go tshugs/(2)pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyal nas khri lo ༄nyi shu bskyangs te zla 2pa'i nang dga' ldan khang gsar du dgongs pa rdzogs/ (3)sras gzhon pa 'gyur med rnam rgyal la gong ma chen pos tho rgyun jun wang zhes pa'i cho lo dang / pha dus ltar bod kyi las don gyi byed po gtso bor bsko bzhag stsal ba dang 'brel gser tham chen mo skad yig sum sbyar ma zhal ris su dbus gtsang gi bka' slob bya ba byed mkhan tho jun wang gi tham ga zhes 'khod pa stsal/ khri lo bzhi bskyangs/spyi lo 1750/ lcags rta/ (1)zla 10tshes 13nyin am ban h+pha chin dang las rogs kyis sras 'gyar med rnam rgyal khrom gzigs khang sdo bskongs/ 'gyar med rnam rgyal gyis ༄gong mar ngo rgol dang / tā la'i bla mthe brtsi 'jog merdo pa/ gcen po 'gyur med tshe brtan bkrongs pa/ sog po jun gar bar ngan 'brel byas pa sogs sdig nyes mang tsam bgrangs nas ral gri bsnun te bsad/ (2)'gyar med rnam rgyal gyi rjes 'brangs pa mgron gnyer blo bzang bkra shes sogs kyis༄ khrom gzigs khang gi nye 'gram du dmag 'thab chu tshod 'ga' zhig byas mthar am ban h+pha chin dang / las rogs lab tun sogs dpon dmag brgya lhag tsam bkrongs/zhu sa cha der da lta'ang rgya 'bum sgang zhes zer/ de bzhin rgya rigs tshong pa sogs mi grangs nyis brgya tsam rtse pho brang da bros te tā la'i bla mar srog skyob zhus/ (3) rdo ring no yon paṇ+ḍi ta bod skyi bya

rgyal po'i las tshab tu bsko bzhag stsal/ (4)pho lha ba'i sras bgres pa 'gyur med tshe brtan gyi sras 'gyur med dbang rgyal la gung gi cho lo gnang /sbyi lo 1751/ lcags lug gong mas bod du btsugs pa'i jun wang kre ste rgyal po'i lam lugs med par bzos/ bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang tā la'i bla ma dang / am ban gnyis thun mong nas 'dzin dgos pa'i bka' phab/bka' shag dngos su btsugs nas bka' blon gtso bo rdo ring no yon paṇ+ḍi ta mgon po dngos grub rab brtan dang / las rogs mdo mkhar zhabs drung tshe ring dbang rgyal/ dza sag thon pa srid gcod tshe brtan/ rtse mgron dar han nyi ma rgyal mtshan bcas bsko bzhag thog bka' shag gi dam phyug bde skyid ma dang /rtags dam sel dam bcas gnang / drung mgron 'gag gsum te bka' drung dang / bka' mgron/ 'gag pa bcas btsugs pa'i srol gtod/ de nas las don gyi dgos mkhor brten yig tshang las khungs kyang gsar du btsugs/spyi lo 1754/ shing khyi/ rdo khru gzhis kyi khrul chag skor rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos 'bras ljongs par gtan tshig gnang /sbyi lo 1755/ shing phag rgyal ba bskal bzang rgya mtshos bun rnying rtsa chag gnang /sbyi lo 1757/ me glang / (1)zla 2tshes 3nyin rgyal dbang bskal bzang rgya mtsho bgrang bya lnga bcu son te dgongs pa rdzogs/ zla shas ring zhabs pad thun mong nas srid 'gan yongs su rdzogs/ (2)bod spyi tshogs gros bsdar spyi mos mgrin gcig gis am ban rnam gnyis brgyud gong mar gser snyasna sgron/ zla 4 tshes 5nyin bka' phyir phebaso ltar/ de mo ho thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho sde bstan gling de mo rgyal thog dang po zla 6tshes 1nyin srid skyong khrir mnga' gsol/ des khri lo nyer gcig bskyangs/55

sbyi lo 1758/ sa stag 6tshes 2nyin tā la sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho gtsang thob rgyal lha ri sgang du ska bltams/sbyi lo 1759/ sa yos/ gong ma chen thos bstan gling de mo'i rgyal thog dang po ha thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtshor 'ja' sa dang / dngu〉 tham gyi 'bru don du bod kyi las don 'khur 'dzin zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin byed dpal ldan no min han gyi tham ga zhes 'khod pa stsal/ de nas bzung bod la srid skyong dang rgyal tshab btsugs pa'i srol dngos su dar/spyi lo 1762/ chu rta/ zla 7ches 7nyin tā la brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mnyes thang bde ba can nas gdan drangs te/ tshes 10nyin po tā la'i mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khri la mnga' gsol/ spyi lo 1765/ shing bya/tā la brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshos paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes kyi drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa blangs/sbyi lo 1766/ me khyi/ paṇa chen drug pa dpal ldan ye shes la 'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos gser gyi tham ga dang 'ja' sa stsal/sbyi lo 1767/ me phag 6tshes 24nyin dar han mkhan po bskal bzang yon tan la gong mas dza sag bla ma'i rim pa dang / bka' blon bsko bzhagaji lo 1768/ sa byi/ bka' blon dga' bzhi ba(rdo ring)spro bo'i zhib dpyod du thon/spyi lo 1769/ sa glang / bal yul du gor kha mi rigs kyi rgyal rabs gsar du btsugs/sbyi lo 1770/ lcags stag de mo ho thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi nyams gso'i spyi 56

'doms su phebs/sbyi lo 1771 / lcags yos/ (1)de mo ho thog thu ngag dbang 'jam dpal bde legs rgya mtsho zla 10tshes shar du bsam yas nas lha sar phyir phebs mdzad/ (2)gor kha'i rgyal po sla sna gshegs/ de'i bu zhin hā phu sa tha phu rgyal por bskos/ji lo 1775/ zhing lug gor kha'i rgyal po shin pho phu sa tha phu'i bu sla sna pa ha tur gor kha'i rgyal por bskos/ 'on kyang kho pa lo na chung ba'i dbang gis don du srid dbang a khus bzung / des rgya bskyed ring lugs kyi byed thabs 'dzin te 'bras ljongs sogs bod kyi sa cha 'ba' zhig 'dzin/sbyi lo 1776/ me sprel/ (1)tā la brgyad pa bsam yas nyams gso'i rab gnas su phebs/ de nas dpal ldan 'bras spungs su phyir phebs mdzad/ (2)'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos paṇa chen dpal ldan ye shes rgyal sa pe cing du phebs dgos pa'i bka' phab/sbyi lo 1777/ me bya/ (1)zla 1tshes 22nyin de mo ho thog thu 'jam dbyangs bde legs rgya mtsho lha ldan bstan rgyas gling du dgongs pa rdzoṭa/(2)zla 8tshes 15nyin gong ma chen por gser snyan sgron pa ltar dga' ldan khri zur er ti ni no min han tshe smon gling rgyal thog dang po ngag dbang tshul khrims bod rje'i khrir mnga' gsol/ des snga phyi sdoms srid lo 20bskyangs/(3)tā la sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/spyi lo 1778/ sa khyi/ (1)tā la 'jam dpal rgya mtsho se ra dang /dga' ldan/ chos 'khor rgyal/ sto gnas bcas su phebs/ (2)pho lha ba'i brgyud pa 'gyur med dbang rgyal 'das pas der bu med stabs phun tshogs dbang po'i bu phun tshogs la gung gi cho lo dang 'ja' sa stsal/ (3)tshe smon 67
