gling er ti ni ngag dbang tshul khrims dga' lngan gse/ra zir phebs/spyi lo 1779/ sa phag (1)zla 4tshes 25nyin tā la 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mchog rgyal ba 'brom ston pa'i gdan sa rwa sgreng du yangs can brgyud gnas mjal du phebs/ tshe smon gling no min han ngag dbang tshul khrims soṭa chibs zhabs su bcar/ (2)gong ma chan lung gis gdan drangs pa ltar paṇa chen sku phreng drug pa dpal ldan ye shes ska 'khor zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa sog po brgyud mes rgyal rgyal sa pe cing t+t+waṃ phebs/ gong ma mchog nas bsu ba dang zhabs tog gang legs mdzad/ sbyi lo 1780/ lcags khyi/ (1)paṇa che na dpal ldan ye shes la gong ma mchog nas g.yang snyi'i sam khru dang / g.yang ṭi'i tham ga stsal/ (2)zla 10tshes 4nyin pan chen dpal ldan ye shes lha 'brum snang nas dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/ de'i ska gdung bod du 'dren padro bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas bka' blon thon pa pe gcing du btang /spyi lo 1781/ lcags glang / (1)gong ma chan lung gi bka' bkod ltar tā la 'jam dpal rgya mtsho lugs gnyis bdag por mnga' gsol/ chin khral sgo mang ho thog thu'i gdong 'bru don du nub phyogs mchog tu dge ba'i zhing gi rgyal dbang sa steng rgyal bstan yongs kyi bdag po thams cad mkhyen pa badz+ra t+ta ra tā la'i bla ma'i tham ga zhes 'khod pa'i skad yig gsum sbyar gyi gser tham che mo dang 'ja' sa stsal/ (2)lo 'dir pan chen ska phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma sku bltams/ cu sbyi lo 1782/ chu stag 'di nas bzung tshe smon gling rgyal thog dang po ngag dbang tshul khrims khrir bzhugs thog rgyal ba 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang lhan sbrel gyis lugs gnyis kyi thugs 'gan lo lnga tsam bzhes/68

sbyi lo 1783/ chu yos/ pho lha ba'i rgyad pa gung nor bu phun tshoṭa la mes po 'gyur med tshe brtan gyi dmag don byas rjes la gzhigs nas gung gi cho lo mi brgyud la 'jags gnas stsal/spyi lo 1784/ shing 'drug 8tshes 13nyin paṇa chen ska phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma gdan sa'i khrir 'khod/ gong ma chen pos gsem dam dang 'ja' sa stsal/sbyi lo 1786/ me rta/ (1)rgyal dbang 'jam dpal rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi 'gan bdag gir lo lnga bzhes/ (2)gong ma'i rtsa ba'i bla ma lcang skya rol pa'i rdo rje dgongs pa rdzogs/ de'i sku tshab tu tshe smon gling ngag dbang tshul khrims pe cing du gdan drangs/ srid skyong 'di nyid kyi mdzad rjes la gzhigs nas dngul dam che mo rang 'jags su gsol ras stsal/spyi lo 1787/ me lug gong ma chen po'i bka' mngags rta tshag rje drung sbo li thu no min han stag sgo khang gsar du bzhugs te bka' blon las rogs lo bzhi mdzad/sbyi lo 1788/ sa sprel/ (1)gor kha ba'i 'go pa sur par dā pos bod la dpung 'jug byas te skyed rong dang / gnya' lam/ rdzong kha bcas btsan bzung byas/ gong ma chen pos blon chen pa drung dang dran tu'i dmag dpon chen po o hu sogs 'go dmag bod du btang / (2)gor bod dmag 'khrug thengs gnyis pa'i spyi khyab tu bka' blon g.yu thog dang / mda' dpon lcang lo can/ dga' bzhi ba thon/ (3)rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor la gong mas tog sgro stsal/ (4)de'i dus bka' blon rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor dang / skal bzang rnam rgyal/ bkra shis don grub/ bsod nams bkra shis bcas yin/69

sbyi zurgo 1789/ sa bya/ tā la 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dang / rta tshag rgyal tshab bkra shis lhan por mchod sdong rab gnas dang legs skyes 'bul bar phebs pa dang 'brel ༄paṇa chen sku phreng bdun par blo bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma phyogs las rnam par rgyal zhes pa'i mtshan gsol/sbyi lo 1790/ lcags khyi/ (1)gong ma chan lung gi bka' ltar rta tshag rje drung sbo li thu ste rta tshag rgyal thog dang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po pe cing du gdan drangs/ (2)tshe smon gling rgyal thog dang po ngag dbang tshul khrims tā la 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i ram 'degs su gtong gnang mdzad de zla 12tshes 9nyin pe cing nas bod du 'byor/spyi lo 1791/ lcags phag (1)zla 3tshes 17nyin/ tshe smon gling rgyal thog dang po ngag dbang tshul khrims rtse pho brang du dgongs pa rdzogs/(2)rta tshag rgyal thog dang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po pe cing du phebs pa'i lam bar nas phyir log mdzad/ zla 8tshes 8nyin lha sar phyir phebs nas tā la 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i phyag rogs gnang ste srid lo bcu bzhi bskyangs/ (3)gor kha bas slar yang bod la btsan 'dzul byas te gnya' lam btsan bzung thog bka' blon rdo ring bstan 'dzin dpal 'byor bal yul du btsan 'khrid byas/ de nas rim bzhin skyid rong dang / gting skyes/ ding ri bzung / gor kha'i dmag dpung gzhis rtse bar 'ongs te bkra shis lhan po'i gna' rdzas gal chen mtha' dag 'phrog gtsang dang / stod khul gyi mi r+shamangs la gnar gcod tshad med btang / ra lug mang che ba bcom/ (4)paṇa chen ska phreng bdan pa blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma gzhis rtse nas lha sar jes phebs༄/sbyi lo 1792/ chu byi/ (1)gong ma chen po'i bka' bkod ltar/60

dag dge lugs par bsgyur nas bdag thob kun bde gling la gsol ras stsal/(2) pho lha ba'i mi brgyad gung nor bu phun tshogs 'das rjes de'i bu rin chen phun tshogs la gung gi sdu lo stsal//spyi lo 1795/ zhing yos/ (1)chin gong ma chen pos bod kyi thon skyed gong 'phel gtong ched rgya dngul grang nyis khri gnang ba ma zad/ khrul bun rnying pa yongs rdzogs chag yang gnang / (2)klong rdol bla ma ngag dbang blo bzang bgrang bya don drug la phebs te dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 1796/ me 'drug bka' mngags bod bzhugs am ban sung cun bod du phebs te lo bzhi bzhugs/spyi lo 1799/ sa lug (1)zla 1 por am ban sung cun phyir log thog zla ba 'di'i nang am ban g.yin hran bsko bzhag stsal te lo gcig bzhugs/ (2)bka' blon pha lha ba mon gyi zhib dpyod du bskyod/sbyi lo 1800/ lcags sprel/ (1)g.yin am ban skabs su ga khrul thog mar bkal/ (2)zla 1 por g.yin hran am ban gyi tshab tu hā ning bsko bzhag stsal nas bod la lo gcig bzhugs/sbyi lo 1801/ lcags bya/ (1)zla 1 por hā ning am ban phyir log de'i las tshab tu g.yin hran bsko bzhag stsal te slar yang bod du lo gsum bzhugs/ (2)paṇa chen bdun pa blo bzang dpal ldan bstan pa'i nyi ma dga' ldan du phebs/ zla 4tshes 16nyin dge slong gi sdom pa bzhes/sbyi lo 1803/ chu phag 11nang g.yin hran am ban phyir logade'i las tshab tu am ban phu'u ning bsko bzhag gis lo gnyis bzhugs/sbyi lo 1804/ zhing byi/ (1)zla 10tshes 18nyin tā la ska phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho dgung grangs zhe brgyad la phebs te dgorngos pa 62

rdzogs/ (2)de'i gnas tshul gong ma chen por gser snyan sgron pa'i bka' yig dgongs don ltar rta tshag rgyal thog dang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po slar yang lugs gnyis kyi bdag por dbang bskar/ des khri lo drug bskyangs/(3)zla 10nang bod bzhugs phu'u ning am ban cer log 'di lo'i nang de'i las tshab tu tshal pa kha'am mtshan gzhan 'un shin am ban bsko bzhag stsal/ bod la lo gnyis bzhugs/sbyi lo 1805/ shing glang / (1)zla 12tshes 1nyin tā la sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho dkar mdzes sa khul ldan chos 'khor dgon gyi nye 'gram chos 'khor dpon tshang du ska bltams/ (2)zla 10par g.yus ning am ban bod du phebs nas lo rā bzhi tsam lha sar bzhugs/ (3)rta tshag rgyal thog dang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po khri ston mdzad thog srid dam rtsis phul/spyi lo 1807/ me yos/ (1)rab byung bcu bzhi pa 'go tshugs/(2) dgu pa lha babs dus che na skabs tā la dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho ngos 'dzin zhus te gung thang gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs/ der lo gcig bzhuṭa/ji lo 1808/ sa 'khrug (1)zla 9tshes 22nyin tā la sku phreng dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho po tā lar mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir mnga' gsol/ (2)zla 10par bka' mngags bod bzhugs 'un shid am ban lha sar 'byor thog lo gsum bzhugs/spyi lo 1809/ sa sprul/ gong ma dgung lo lnga bcur phebs par rten 'brel zhu ched sba yer phul/sbyi lo 1810/ lcags rta/ (1)rta tshag rgyal thog dang po ye shes blo bzang bstan pa'i mgon po kun bde gling du sku bde bar gshegs/63

(2)zla 10par bka' mngags bod bzhugs yang khrun am ban lha sar 'byor thog lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs/sbyi lo 1811/ lcags lug (1)gong mar gser snyan sgron pa ltar zla 3tshes 27nyin bka' yig phyir phebs te yongs 'dzin de mo blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'jigs med rgya mtsho srid skyong bsko bzhag stsal/ zla 4tshes 11nyin gser khrir mnga' gsol/ gong ma tsā chin gyis er ti ni no min han gyi cho lo dang srid skyong rim pa'i dngul tham che mo/ de mo ska gong ma'i tham ga 'bru don du gong ma'i lung gi zhwa ser bstan pa 'dzin byed dar+shal ldan no min han gyi tham ga bkra shis dge'o zhes pa dang rtags dam/ sel dam bcas rang 'jags su stsal/ khri lo dgu bskyangs/ (2)zla 10pa'i nang bod bzhugs hu'u thu li am ban lha 'byor thog lo bzhi bzhugs/sbyi lo 1813/ chu bya/ (1)tā la dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtsho dgu pa lha babs dus chen nyin rab byung gi mtshan bzhes/ (2)zla 6par rgyal tshab de mo blo bzang thub bstan 'jigs med rgya mtsho bsam yas su bskyod/sbyi lo 1814/ shing khyi/ (1)dbyin jis 'bras ljongs su btsan 'dzul byas/ (2)zla 2par bka' mngags shi ming am ban lha 'byor thog lo ngo bzhi bzhugs/spyi lo 1815/ shing phag (1)zla 2tshes 16nyin rgyal ba lung rtogs rgya mtsho glo bur du dgongs pa rdzogs/ (2)gong ma chen por gser snyan sgron pa bzhin de mo no min han blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'jigs med rgya mtsho rgyal tshab tu bsko bzhag stsal/ zla 10tshes 2nyin srid khrir mnga' gsol/ snga phyi bsdoms khri lo dgu bskyangs/ (3)dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bal por btsan 'dzul byas/64

ji lo 1816/ me byi/ (1)bsam yas gtsug lag khang du me shor bas gsar skrun dang nyams gso'i do dam du bshad sgra don 'grub rdo rje bsko bzhag gnang ste nyams gso mdzad/ (2)zla 3tshes 29nyin tā la sku phreng bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho li thang gnas stod nor bu'i grong du ska bltams/ (3)bal po dmag pham nas dbyin bal dbar 'dra mnyam rlon pa'i chings yig bzhag ste dbyin jis bal po dbang du bsgyur/spyi lo 1817/ me glang / zla 5par bka' mngags bod bzhugs am ban g.yus lin lha 'byor gyis lo ngo bzhi tsam bzhugs/spyi lo 1819/ sa yos/ zla 3tshes 3nyin de mo no min han blo bzang bstan 'dzin 'jigs med rgya mtsho lha ldan bstan rgyas gling du ska gsheṭa/bod bzhugs am ban rnam gnyis nas rgyal ba'i yang srid med stabs r+sham kha khag gnas skabs ring kha bcad gnang ste bka' shag la rtsis sprad/ srid kyi bya ba mtha' dag am ban gnyis dang bka' shag sogs nas mdzad/sbyi lo 1820/ lcags 'drug (1)gser snyan sgron pa'i bka' dgongs bzhin tshe smon gling rgyal thog gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims rgya mtsho srid skyong gi khrir mnga' gsol/ gong ma tsā chin gyis er ti ni mang ngas no min han gyi cho lo dang 'ja' sa gnang ba ma zad/ tshe smon gling sku gong ma'i dam kha 'bru don du bstan pa'i gsal byed er ti ni no min han gyi tham ga rgyal :zhes pa'i thod du dza rtags gsar brkos byas pa dang / dngul dam chen mo/ rta /sa ma sel ma bcas rang 'jags su gnang / (2)lo mjug tu gong ma tsā chen bde bar gshegs pa dang gong ma ta'o kong gser khrir mnga' gsol/(3) zla 10par bka' mngags bod bzhugs am ban 'un kun ming dngos 'un ning lha 'byor thog lo ngo bzhi tsam bzhugs/ (4) bka' blon rta mgrin 65

tshe dbang stod khul du sa bskor du bskyod/sbyi lo 1822/ chu rta/ (1)paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma dbus su phebs thog tā la'i yang srid khag gsum byung bas zla 1tshes 15nyin gser bum dkrugs te tshul khrims rgya mtsho thon/ zla 8tshes 8nyin po tā lar gser khrir mnga' gsol ba dang / rab byung gi sdom pa bzhes/ (2)gong ma ta'o kong gis sngar srol ltar rgyal yab blo bzang snyan grags la gung gi cho lo gnang /sbyi lo 1823/ chu lug (1)zla 7pa'i nang zung thing am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo lnga bzhugs/ (2)smar khams dang sa ngan 'khrug rtsod langs stabs bka' blon bshad sgra ba don 'grub rdo rje zhib dpyod du thon/(3)bka' blon dga' zhi ba sa bskor du bskyod/sbyi lo 1826/ me khyi/ bka' blon zur khang ba tshe brtan rdo rje mon zhib tu bskyod/sbyi lo 1827/ me phag 2pa'i nang bod bzhugs am ban had sha'an lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo bzhi tsam bzhugs/ cusbyi lo 1828/ sa byi/ (1)rdo khra gzhis ku'i khrul chag skor 'bras ljongs par sa dbang pha lha bas gtan tshig gnang / (2)had sha'an am ban dang sa dbang pha lha ba sa bskor du bskyod/ ༄sbyi zusgo 1829/ sa glang / tā la bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho dpal ldan 'bras spungs su chibs bsgyur gnang /spyi r+shatswa 1830/ lcags stag (1)tshe smon gling rgyal thog gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrims rgya mtshos chu lug(1823)lo nas dbus gtsang khul gyi zhing las thon skyed la brtag zhib dang 'brel zhing pa'i dud grangs 66

dang / mi grangs/ las rigs sogs kyi tho gsar du bkod nas sa zhing rkang 'bor stom bsgrigs thog khrul 'ul lam lugs la legs bcos kyis lcags stag zhib gzhung gsar du bskos/ (2)zla 7par bkas mngags bod bzhugs shin kha'o am ban lha 'byor thog lo ngo bzhi bod du bzhugs/ (3)rgyal ba sku phreng bcu pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho se rar chibs bsgyur mdzad/ (4)gong ma ta'o kong dgung lo lnga bcu phebs par rten 'brel zhu ched sba yer phul/sbyi lo 1833/ chu sprul/ zla 1po'i nang shin kha'o am ban phyir log de'i las tshab tu lung 'un am ban lha 'byor thog lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs/spyi lo 1834/ zhing rta/ (1)bka' blon bshad sgra don grub rdo rje spo zhib tu bskyod/ (2)bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban 'un dbus lha 'byor thog lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs/sbyi lo 1835/ zhing lug (1)spo bo ku gnam pas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi khrul ma khur stabs spo bor dpung 'jug byas/ mthar bod bzhugs chin rlud am ban sogs 'dum 'grigs mdzad de spo bo ka gnam pas lo ltar lha ldan gtsug lag khang dang bsam yas gtsug lag khang du rgyun mchod mchod mar 'bul rgyu gtan 'bebs mdzad/ (2)gong ma mchog gis spo zhib bka' blon zur khang tshe brtan rdo rje dang bshad sgra don 'grub rdo rje'i byas rjes la gzhigs te rim pa gnyis pa'i go gnas stsal/ (3)bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban chen rlud lha 'byor thog bod la lo gcig bzhugs/sbyi lo 1836/ me sprel/ (1)'jam dbyangs gong ma chen pos bka' blon zur khang tshe brtan rdo rjes spo bor dmag las byas rjes la gzhigs te thas ji mi thog gsum dang / bka' blon bshad sgra don 'grub rdo rjes rgya 67

mdar bca' sdod kyi dmag spyi'i las ka 'thus tshang byung bar thas ji mi thog gsum bcas stsal/ (2)bka' blon rta mgrin tshe dbang gis phogs rdzas rta khal sogs byed sgo 'thus tshang byung bar tog gnas gnang / (3)bkas mngags bod sdod /'on hra'ang spa'o am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo bzhi bzhugs/sbyi lo 1837/ me bya/ zla 9tshes 1nyin rgyal ba tshul khrims rgya mtsho dgung grangs 21la phebs te rtse pho brang du dgongs pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 1838/ sa khyi/ (1)zla 9tshes 2nyin tā la bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho mi nyag mgar thar dgon pa'i nye 'gram du sku 'khrungs/(2)gong ma mchog gis bka' blon bshad sgra don 'grub rdo rje dang bka' blon zur khang tshe brtan rdo rjes spo bor dpung 'jug byed skabs byas rjes bzhag par brten slar yang thas ji mi thog re 'phar sgon stsal/sbyi lo 1839/ sa phag 10par bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban mi'ang spa'o lha 'byor thog lo ngo bzhi tsam bzhugs/sbyi lo 1840/ lcags byi/ (1)nyal tha'i dmag 'khrug langs/(2)zla 4par tshe smon gling rgyal thog gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khri mas rgya mtsho dga' ldan du phebs/ de rjes gzhis rtser phebs/sbyi lo 1841 / lcags glang / (1)zla 6tshes 14nyin yang srid khag gsum po gser bum dkrugs te mkhas grub rgya mtsho yang srid du thon/gong ma chen po sngar srol ltar rgyal khab tshe dbang don 'grub la gung gi cho lo gnang / (2)sing dmag gis ru thog dang / rtsa hreng / spu hreng sogs btsan bzung byas/ de'i dpung 'jug spyi khyab tu bka' blon thas ji zur khang tshe brtan rdo rje dang mdo mkhar bsod nams dbang rgyal bcas bsko bzhag stsal/68

spyi lo 1842/ chu stag (1)mnga' ris sa khuladu gang / shugs chen babs/ sing dmag dang bod dmag g.yul 'gyed pas nang dmas/ rnams grang zug mi theg par pham nyes tshabs chen byung / sing dmag gi 'go pa so la wa shin dang dmag mi nyis brgya tsam tshar bcad/ la dwags pa'i blon po gnyis dang dmag mi brgyad brgya tsam gson por bzung / mnga' ris khul gyi sa cha yongs rdzogs tshur blangs/ (2)la seng dmag don gyi byas rjes la gzhigs te bka' blon mdo mkhar ba bsod nams dbang rgyal la cho lo stsal/ (3)tā la bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho po tā la'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/ gong ma chen pos chin khrul lcang skya rin po che'i gdong 'ja' sa dang gser dam stsal/(4)zla 11par bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban had h+pha lha 'byor thog lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs/ stospyi lo 1843/ chu yos/ bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban bod du 'byor/ zla 8pa'i nang had rgyu am ban gyi tshab rma'ang spa'o bsko bzhag stsal/ zla 10par rma'ang spa'o am dron gyi tshab tu byi'i hran bod bzhuṭa am ban bsko bzhag thog lo ngo bzhi tsam bod du bzhugs/sbyi lo 1844/ zhing 'drug (1)bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul mi mthun par tshe smon gling rgyal thog gnyis pa ngag dbang 'jam dpal tshul khrimasargya mtsho gnas dbyung btang ba ma zad/ sgos gzhis gzhung bzhes thog mes rgyal nang khul du bskrad/ (2)lo 'dir sngon tshud nas gser snyan sgron pa bzhin/ paṇa chen er te ni bstan pa'i nyi ma lha sar gdan drangs/ shing 'brug(1844)zla 8tshes 9nas shing sbrul(1845)zla 4tshes 26bar lugs gnyis kyi 'gan yongs su bzhes/byi lo 1845/ shing sprul/ (1)zla 4tshes 26nyin rwa smreng rgyal 69

thog dang po ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan lke srid kyi/ nga bskos/'dis rgyal thog snga phyi gnyis gnang ba'i snga ma'i skabs yin/ gong ma chen po ta'o kong gis a chi ho thog thu'i cho lo gnang / khri lo bcu gcig bskyangs/(2)zla 4tshes 13nyin paṇa chen er te ni bstan pa'i nyi ma srid skyong dgongs zhus kyis gzhis rtser phyir phebs mdzad/sbyi lo 1846/ me rta/ (1)dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas kha shi mi ri dang la dwags btsan bzung byas/ (2)tā la mkhas grub rgya mtshos rab byung gi mtshan bzhes/ (3)bkas mngags bod bzhugs spring le'ang am ban lha 'byor gyis lo ngo gsum tsam bzhugs/sbyi lo 1847/ me lug bka' blon bshad spa dbang phyug rgyal pos brag g.yab zhib dpyod 'thus tshang byung bar brten thas ji mi thog gcig stsal/spyi lo 1848/ sa sprel/ zla 1 nang spring le'ang am ban 'das tshab tu am ban mu'u thang rnga bod 'byor thog lo ngo lnga bzhugs/sbyi lo 1851/ lcags phag bsam yas nyams gso'i do dam du bka' blon bshad sgra ba dbang phyug rgyal po bsko bzhag stsal/sbyi lo 1852/ chu byi/ (1)tā la ska phreng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtsho se 'bras dang dga' ldan chos 'khor༄ rgyal sogs la chibs bsgyur mdzad/ (2)bkas mngags bod bzhugs had krang am ban lha 'byor thog lo ngo gnyis tsam bzhugs/sbyi lo 1853/ chu glang / (1)zla 1tshes 8nyin paṇa chen ska phreng bdun pa bstan pa'i nyi ma dgongs pa chos dbyings su gshegs/ (2)zla dīpar had krang am ban gyi tshab tu 'un ud am ban bsko gzhag stsal/ zla 5par mam ban de dag phyir 'then lhag bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban ho mi

tha ho'o gsar bskos lha 'byor thog lo ngo lnga bzhugs/spyi lo 1854/ shing stag (1)paṇa chen ska phreng brgyang pa blo bzang bstan pa'i dbang phyug ska bltams/ (2)mkhar kha rje btsun dam pa lha phebs thog rab byung gi sdom spro blangs/sbyi lo 1855/ zhing yos/ (1)gong ma zhan phung mchog gi bka' ltar tā la ska phreng bcu gcig pa mkhas grub rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi 'gan bzhes/ rtson kyang zla 12tshes 24nyin tho rengs stag gi thog bgrang bya 18la phebs te glo bur du dgongs pa rdzogs/ (2)de ma thag tu spyi tshogs mos bsdar gyis gser snyan sgron pa ltar/ rwa sgreng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims )la mtshan gyis slar yang lugs gnyis kyi 'gan bzhes/ (3)sho khrul dang tshong par bkag 'gog byas par kha g.yar nas gor kha bas dmag mi stong phrag 'ga' zhig btang nas gnya' lam dang / skyed rong / rdzong kha bcas ham bzung byas/ gor bod dmag gzir byang bas de'i spyi khyab ta bka' blon bkras khang thon/ ༄ ༄spyi lo 1856/ me 'drug (1)zla 12tshes 1 nyin tā la sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho 'ol dga' rdzong phyi'i nye 'dabs sbag 'brog nyang tshang du 'khrungs/ (2)'dra mnyam min pa'i gor bod 'ching yig bzhagade nas lo ltar gor kha bar dngul ru si chig tsam slog dgos pa ma zad/ lha sar gor kha dpon po bca' sdod dang bal po'i tshong pas lha sar bca' sdod kyis tshong gnyer chog pa'i dmigs bsal dbang cha 'dzin/sbyi lo 1857/ me sprul/ zla 5par bkas mngags bod bzhugs man chin am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo gsum bzhugs/smyu lo 1858/ sa rta/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs su bod 7 /

bzhugs am ban ngo phebs thog yang srid khag gsum gser bum dkrugs pas 'phrin las rgya mtsho yang srid du thon/sbyi lo 1859/ sa lug (1)zla 10par bkas mngags bod bzhugs khrung hre am ban lha 'byor thog lo ngo gsum bzhugs/ (2)bka' blon rdo ring ba sho mdo khul du zhib dpyod du bskyod/spyi lo 1860/ lcags sprel/ (1)zla /tshes 3nyin tā la bcu gnyis pa rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang dpal bzang po ste 'phrin las rgya mtsho po tā la'i gser khrir mnga' gsol/ (2)rgyal tshab rwa sgreng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gtsang du phebs/ (3)dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas 'bras ljongs rgyal por btsan shed kyis tshong ra dang lcags lam 'dzugs rgyu khas blangs bcugasbyi lo 1861/ lcags bya/ bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban cin 'un lha 'byor thog bod du lo ngo brgyad bzhugs/sbyi lo 1862/ chu khyi/ (1)rwa sgreng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyis rgyal thog phyi mar srid lo brgyad bskyangs/ de nas bod kyi dbang bsgyur gral rim nang khul du srid dbang 'phrog len byed pa'i 'thab rtsod rno ngar ches cher phyin te/ 'bras spungs ri gra che mo'i gtong sgo'i skor nas 'khrug rkyen langs te rgyal tshab rwa sgrong srid dam khyer nas mes rgyal nang khul du bros/ (2)bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal po bod rje'i khrir bskos/ gong ma chen pos no min han gyi cho lo stsal/ (3)rwa sgreng skor rnyog zing langs stobs cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo dus thog tu tshogs mi thub par zla 9pa'i nang gzhi nas smon lam tshugs/sbyi lo 1863/ chu phag (1)gong ma thung skru mchog gis rwa sgeng 72

rgyal tshab bod du phyir log thog sgos gzhis rang 'jags sprod dgos pa'i bka' phab/ 'on kyang rwa sgreng ngag dbang ye shes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan phyir log phebs pa'i lam bar sku gshegs/ de'i sgos gzhis rnams rwa sgreng dgon par phyir log mdzad/ (2)sa dbang phu lung ba dpon dmag rnams nas nyag rong mgon po rnam rgyal gyi dmag mi rnams pham nyes su btang ste dbang du bsdas/(3)dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas 'brug pa'i sa khongs su btsan shed kyir+sha tshong lam btsugs stabs dbyin 'brag dmag 'khrug dang po langs te 'brag par rgyal /ba 11tshob/ ri ri sbyi lo 1864/ zhing byi/ (1)zla 8tshes 25nyin gyi nub mo sde srid bshad sgra dbang phyug rgyal po nor gling bskal bzang pho brang du dgongs pa rdzogs/ (2)gser snyan sgron pa ltar dga' ldan khri zur yongs 'dzin mkhyen rab dbang phyug ste sde drug bod rje'i khrir dbang bskur/ gong ma mchog gis ho thog thu'i cho lo stsal/ srid lo bcu tsam bskyangs/ (3)nyag rong mgon po rnam rgyal pha bu gnyis nas gong mar ngo rgol byas stabs gong ma chen po'i bka' bkod ltar bod dmag btang nas drag gnon byas te mgon po rnam rgyal bsad/de'i bu bros shor/ (4)nyag sked(nyag rong sa dkyil)dmag 'khrug gi byas rjes la gzhigs te gong ma mchog gis bka' blon pad+ma rgyal po la rma sgro dang /rdo don la rim pa gnyis pa'i tog phun tshogs tshe dbang rdo rjer rim pa gnyis pa'i tog dang rma sgro/ tshe dbang dpal 'bar la rma sgro/ spyi mkhan blo bzang dpal ldan la cho lo bcas stsal/sbyi lo 1865/ zhing glang / (1)nyag rong mgon po rnam rgyal pha bu gnyis nas gong mar bka' gyen log byas stabs gong ma'i bka' bkod ltar/ bod dmag btang nas drag gnon byas par brten nyag rong gi sa mi 73

mtha' dag bdag gnyer gyi dbang cha tā la'i bla ma mchog la stsal/ (2)dbyin ji'i dpon ngan ad tang bsad par kha g.yar te dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pas smyo ham chen pos 'brug yul du btsan 'dzul byas/sbyi lo 1866/ me stag (1)bod phyogs nas rang nyid kyi sa khongs bston med lung thur lar so lta khang btsugs/ (2)gong ma mchog gis tā la sku phreng bcu gnyis pa'i yab phun tshogs tshe dbang snga lo nad mnar 'das rjes 'di'i gcen po ye shes nor bu dbang phyag la gang gi cho lo brgyud 'dzin gnang / ༄ ༄sbyi lo 1867/ me yos/ rab byung bco lnga pa 'go tshugs/sbyi lo 1868/ sa 'drug (1)dpal ldan don 'grub spyi khyab mkhan por bsko bzhag stsal/ kho pa ni shes rgya dman zhing 'jigs nyams che ba dang gdug rtsub che zhing g.yo thabs mkhas pa zhig yod/ (2)zla 6par cin 'un am ban gyi las tshab tu se lin am ban bsko bzhag stsal yang bod du las 'gan 'khur bar ma slebs/ (3)tā la sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor tshogs phebs gnang / de nas bzung tā la'i bla ma tshogs phebs gnang ba'i 'go tshugs/sbyi lo 1869/ sa sprul/ zla 2par cin 'un am ban gnas dbyung btang / zla 3par se lin am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo lnga tsam bzhugs/sbyi lo 1870/ lcags rta/ tā la'i bla ma 'phrin las rgya mtsho se 'bras chibs bsgyur gnang /spyi lo 1871/ lcags lug (1)spyi mkhan dpal ldan don 'grub dang kho pa'i rjes 'brangs pa rnams kyi bya spyod la gzhigs te dpal ldan 74

ngon grub dang bshad sgra tshe ring dbang phyug grags bshes sne gdong bcas 'dzin bzung byas/ dga' ldan shar rtse mkhan po grags pa rgya mtsho gsang sngaṭa rdzong dang / dga' ldan byang rtse mkhan po ye shes chos 'phel gnyal brag sgor la rgyang 'bud btang / byed gte tog gnas yod pa mi drug bsad/ de bzhin ngan gzhoms byed mkhan tre hor dge zur dang shod dza lag 'bras spungs nas 'dzin bzung byas te 'jam 'dri byas pa'i gnas tshul sogs mkhan po dpal ldan don grub dang bshad sgra gnyis nas shes rtogs byung rjes g.yo thabs la brten nas dga' ldan du bros/ dga' ldan pas khong gnyis rtsis 'bul ma zhus par brten bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang dga' ldan bar dmag 'khrug langs/kong dmag gis dga' ldan blangs pas grwa pa mang che ba mgo btags spyi mkhan dpal ldan don grub dang rjes 'brangs pa mi bcu gnyis mtshan mo gung dkar rdzong khongs rgya ma brgyud bros pa'i skabs der bod dmag gis rjes bsnyegs btang / 'jigs snang gis rang srog lcebs/ (2)bka' blon mtsho sgo ba las rdon thad rang shed lhag par che bas gnas dbyung btang / (3)rdo rje g.yib bod du 'ongs nas 'bra8 ge spungs dgon par grwa pa byas rjes su u ru su'i gsang nyul du gyur/sbyi lo 1872/ chu sprel/ (1)srid zur mkhyen rab dbang phyug dgongs pa rdzogs/ (2) 'di nas bzung snga rjes su u ru su'i dmag dpon phu rje war si ci dang lo'o phu blo su si ci sogs shin cang brgyud nag chu'i bar slebs/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas stabs mtsho sngon du phyir logasbyi lo 1873/ chu bya/ (1)tā la ska phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dgung grangs bco brgyad la phebs te zlogs gnyis kyi 'ganaskabangs ཿ6

su bzhes/ (2)zla lhapar so chen am ban gyi las tshab dran cig am ban lha 'byor thog lo gcig tsam bzhugs/sbyi lo 1874/ shing khyi/ (1)gong ma thung tri bde bar gshegs/(2)zla 5tshes 4nyin tā la 'phrin las rgya mtsho dga' ldan dang / chos 'khor rgyal/ lho gnas bcas la phebs/ (3)zla 9par drin cis am ban 'das de'i las tshab zung lin am ban lha 'byor thog lo ngo drug bzhugs/sbyi lo 1875/ shing phag (1)gong ma kwang zhu gser khrir mnga' gsol/ (2) zla 8tshes 20nyin tā la sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho dgang lo nyi shur son te dgongs pa rdzogs/ (3)zla shas ring bod kyi las don gyi zlogan yongs rdzogs bka' shag nas blangs/ de rjes rta tshag rje drang ho thog thu ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan te kun gling rgyal thog r+shanyis pa khrir bskos/sbyi lo 1876/ me byi/ (1)zla 5tshes 5nyin tā la sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtsho dwags po glang mdun du sku 'khrungs/ (2)srid skyong rta tshag rje drang ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan se 'bras chibs bsgyur gnang / /3)dbyin jig slar yang 'brug yul du btsan 'dzul byas/(4)u ru su'i ngo dpon ti'i zer bra bod du bskor nyul du yong bar bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang ser skya mi da ngas yongs nas ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas/ sbyi lo 1877/ me glang / (1)gong ma kwang zhu mchog gis srid skyong rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan la rgyal tshab thong shan gyi cho lo phebs/ (2)zla 11tshes 14nyin rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho dwags po nas gung thang du gdan drangs/76

sbyi lo 1878/ sa stag (1)zla 1tshes 4nyin/ paṇa chen bstan pa'i dbang phyug lha sar phebs 'bral gung thang du tā la'i yang srid rin po che mjal bar phebs/ (2)bod bzhugs am ban mchog gis rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol chog pa'i gser snyan sgron/spyi lo 1879/ sa yos/ (1)gong ma chen po'i bka' phyir phebs bzhin zla 6tshes 24nyin rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho gser khrir mnga' gsol/(2)srid skyong rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan ye shes chos kyi rgyal mtshan tā la sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yongs 'dzin du bsko bzhag stsal/ (3)zla 10par/zung lin am ban gyi las tshab tu zas blang rngo mam ban lha 'byor thog bod du lo ngo bdun bzhugs/spyi lo 1881/ lcags sprul/ rgyal tshab rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan ye shes chos kyi rgyal mtshan chos 'khor rgyal dang / sto gnas su phebs/de'i ring srid 'gan bka' blon lha klu gung dang / bka' blon bla ma blo bzang yon tan/ mdo mkhar ba tshe dbang nor bu/ g.yu thog lha dbang rdo rje/ ram pa bkra shis dar rgyas bcas nas byas/spyi lo 1882/ chu rta/ tā la thub bstan rgya mtshos rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyi drung nas rab byung gi sdom pa blangs/sbyi lo 1883/ chu lug (1)zla 6par/ paṇa chen sku phreng brgyad pa bstan pa'i nyi ma bde bar gshegs/ (2)tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho sto gnas su phebs/ (3)paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma dwags por sku bltams/ (4)smon lam skabs su lha sar bal po'i tshong pa dang / bod rigs ser skya mi dmangs dbar 'khrug rtsod langs/sbyi lo 1885/ zhing bya/ (1)tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho dang /srid stong rta tshag ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan sogs bsam yas 77

gtsug lag khang du chibs basbyar mdzad/ (2)zla 11par/ bod bzhugs 'un hre am ban lha 'byor thor+sha bod la lo ngo gsum bzhugs/sbyi lo 1886/ me khyi/ (1)kun gling rta tshag rgyal thog gnyis pa ngag dbang dpal ldan chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis khri lo bcu gnyis bskyangs te/zla 4tshes 8nyin nyi nub khar rtse shar brgyad du dgongs pa rdzogs (2)de 'phral de mo ho thog thu ngag dbang blo drozang 'phrin las rab rgyas te bstan gling de mo'i rgyal thog gsum pa zla 5tshes 12nyin srid 'dzin las tshab tu bsko bzhag stsal/ de rjes zla 9tshes 13nyin gong ma chen po'i bka' yig phyir phebs ltar/ srid skyong gi khrir mnga' gsol/ (3)de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas bsam yas gtsug lag khang gi rab gnas su phebs/spyi lo 1887/ me phag (1)zla snams 15nyin/ dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa'i kha gnon du 'bras ljongs sa mtshams su mda' dpon lha lding sras dang / las rogs rtse mgron bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ kong dmag dang bcas pa btang / de rjes dmag sgar spyi khyab bka' blon lha klu dang /ram pa dbus mda' nga phod/ gzhis rtser sdod res mda' dpon mkhar sna dang skyid sdod bcas bskyod/ (2)zla 9tshes 5nyin/ srid skyong de mo yongs 'dzin bgres pa'i gsar mjal zhus/sbyi lo 1888/ sa byi/ (1)zla 2tshes 7nyin/ dbyin ji'i dpon dmag lnga brgya tsam gyis glo bur du lung thur la gshams nas tshur rgol byas/ bod dmag dang 'thab pas dbyin ji btsan 'dzul pa dmag shor nas phyir bros/ (2)zla 3tshes 5nyin/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho se 'bras chibs bsgyur mdzad de 'bras spungs su dbu ma gsan bzhes gnang / (3)'jam dbyangs gong ma chen po'i bka' ltar/ zla 2tshes 15nyin/ gser bum 78

dkrugs te chos kyi nyi ma paṇa chen ska phreng dgu par ngos 'dzin byas/ zla 2tshes 23nyin/ gzhis rtse bde chen ༄pho brang du gser khrir mnga' gsol/ (4)zla 1por/ bkas mngags bod bzhugs drang ging am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo gsum bzhugs/sbyi lo 1889/ sa glang / (1)zla 3par/ gong ma'i bka' ltar/ bod bzhugs am ban hreng thad ka li ka tar chings yig bzhag par bskyod/ (2)gong ma kwang zhus rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho'i gcen po don grub rdo rjer gung gi go gnas brgyud 'dzin gnang /sbyi 'os 1890/ byurmicigs stag (1)bod phyi sa mtshams sogs skor/ gong ma'i sku tshab byang thad dang / dbyin gzhung sku tshab nyin rda'i spyi khyab las 'dzin pa blon chen ang dang po mnyam 'dzoms thog rgyal tshong chi/sa yig don tshan brgyad bzhag (2)zla 6par/ hreng thad am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo gsum bzhugs/sbyi lo 1891/ lcags yos/ (1)zla 1por/ bod bzhugs am ban hreng thad gro mo rin chen sgang du phebs te dbyin ji'i 'thus mi spa'o yer dang tshong don skor mu mthud de gros mol mdzad/ (2)zla 9par/ bod bzhugs am ban hreng thad gro mo rin chen sgang du dgongs pa rdzogs/ (3)gong ma kwang zhus am ban khu'o nyon dang las rogs yan mu'u bod du gtong gnang mdzad/spyi lo 1893/ chu sprul/ chin krung dbyang srid gzhung gi ska tshab zi khron yo shi dmag sgar gyi tshan sbyangs ho'o phrang yun dang / dpya khrul blang ho dzā/dbyin ji'i sku tshab 'bras ljongs su bca' sdod srid 'dzin dpon rigs spa'o ter bcas snyen mong thog rdo rje gling du sna gdong 'gag sgo'i skor chings yig 7

don tshan dgu bzhagaji lo 1895/ shing lug (1)zla 1tshes 11nyin/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho dgung lo nyi shur phebs te/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang du yongs 'dzin gzhon pa phur lcog blo bzang tshul khrims 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i drung nas dge slong gi sdom pa blangs/ (2)bka' shag dang / ser 'bras dga' gsum gyi 'thus mi'i re 'dun ltar/ de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas rgyal tshab dgongs pa zhus/ (3)zla 8tshes 8nyin/ po tā la'i srid zhi'i pho brang du rgyal dbang thub bstan rgya mtshos rgyal srid chos srid bzhes pa'i mdzad sgo tshugs/sbyi lo 1896/ me sprel/ (1)zla 2nang / bkas mngags bod bzhugs am ban 'un had lha 'byor thog lo ngo lnga bzhugs/ (2)rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho smon lam tshogs phebs thog ston chen bshams/ gsung chos rgya che gnang /sbyi lo 1899/ sa phag (1)bstan gling de mo ngag dbang blo bzang 'phrin las rab rgyas dang nyag sprul sogs 'dzin bzung thog bstan gling chos rar bcug grwa tshang gi rgya dngos rang 'jags thog bla brang gi 'dzin dngos yongs rdzogs gzhung bzhes brteng / mthar de mo ho thog thu stod sa dga' la rgyangs 'bud btang ste sa gnas de ga'i ri shur zhig nang bkrongs/ phyis su der rdo phung zhig dngos su mthong rgya yod zer/ nyang/ sprul rtse shar chen lcog la bcug rjes ske bcad de rang srog globs/ (2)u ru su'i gsang nyul rdo rje g.yib slar yang u ru sur phyir log u ru su'i gong mas kho par mjal 'phrad byas te skog g.yo mang tsam bshams/sbyi lo 1900/ lcags byi/ (1)zla 3par/ rgyal ba thub bstan 80

rgya mtsho ska 'khor dang bcas pa dga' ldan dang / chos 'khor rgyal/ 'khrungs gzhis/ stotho rtsa ri/ sto gnas bcas su chibs bsgyur mdzad/ (2)zla tshipar/ had 'un am ban 'das/ de'i las tshab chin hran am ban bsko bzhag stsal/ yang zla 9par/ chin hran am ban phyir 'then thog las tshab tu g.yul kung mam ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo ngo gsum bzhugs/sbyi lo 1902/ chu stag (1)zla 4tshes 15nyin/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang du paṇa chen chos kyi nyi mas tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes te gtsang la phyir phebs gnang / (2)zla 11par g.yu thas am ban lha 'byor thog bod la lo lnga bzhugs/spyi lo 1903/ chu yos/ (1)zla 3tshes 7nyin/ krung nyin sa mtshams don gnad sogs skor gros mol byed par gong ma chen po'i bka' bzhin/ bod bzhugs am ban gyis gnas gsum pa'i kre : had 'un zhi'i dang gro mo'i dpya khrul si spa dar/ mkhan drung blo bzang 'phrin las/ dbus mda' tsha rong dbang phyug rgyal po bcas 'thus mi bzhi dang / las byar rtse drung dge 'dun chos dar/ brgya dpon 'gyur med tshe brtan/ lding dpon lnga/ rgya sbyong dmag bcu gnyis bcas btang / dus der dmag dpon rung ha'o pheng dang /'bras ljongs su bca' sdod dpon rigs gyod thā nas dbyin ji'i 'thus mi'i ming 'khyer nas dmag mi nyis brgya tsam 'khrid/ bod phyogs la 'brel gtugs rtsa ba nas ma byas par rang mtshams kyis sa mtshams brgal te gam pa rdzong du 'ongs/ (2)zla 12tshes 12nyin/ dbyin ji'i hrang zha'o dmag dpon rung ha'o rgyung gis btsan 'dzul dmag 'bor chen 'khrid de rang rgyal gyi sa cha gro mor btsan 'dzul byas/ (3)bka' blon bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rjes dbyin ji dang ngan 'brel byas stabs gnas dbyung btang /81

tar bskyod/ dngul 'bab tshang ma gong ma tshang nas gnang / (4)paṇa chen dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma rgya gar nas gtsang du phyir phebs mdzad/ (6)zla 10par/ yu'u thad am ban gnas dbyung btang ba'i las tshab tu lan g.yus am ban bsko bzhag thog lha sar lo ngo lnga bzhugs/ sbyi lo 1907/ me lug (1)zla 10pa'i nang / khri zur blo bzang rgyal mtshan la srid skyong bsko bzhag stsal/ zla 11tshes 12nyin srid khrir mnga' gsol/ las rogs su bshad zhol chang gsum bsko bzhag stsal/(2)so nam las khungs dang / ja tsha las khungs gsar du btsugs/ (3)zhabs pad tsha rong sa mtshams don gcod du bskyod/ji lo 1908/ sa sprel/ (1)gong ma kwang zhu'i bka' bzhin/zla 8tshes 3nyin/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho ska 'bum nas ri bo rtse lnga brgyud pe cing du phebs 'byor byung bas/ gong mar+sha mjal 'phrad gnang /(2)zla 9par/ gong ma kwang zhu dang / yum tshe shi'i thad ha'o snga rjes su bde bar gshegs/ (3)zla 10par/ gong ma shongan thung gser khrir mnga' gsol/ (4)zla 10par/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho sku 'khor zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa rgyal sa pe cing nas chibs kha bsgyur te ska 'bum du phebs/sbyi lo 1909/ sa bya/ (1)zla 8par/ rte la thub bstan rgya mtsho ska 'khor dang bcas nag chur 'byor/ zla 10tshes 30nyin/ lha sar phebs nya'abyor byung 'phral bod bzhugs am ban lan yus dang / tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho 'gal ba shugs chen byung / (2)kra'o 'ar phung bod sdod am ban dang / zi khron dang yus nan mtha' mtshams don gcod blon chen du bsko bzhag stsal/ kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag dpung bod du yong nas sde 'bangs mi ser la mnar gcod tshad med btang / (3)zla 11tshes 17nyin/ khri zur 83

blo bzang rgyal mtshan srid skyong dgongs pa zhus thog blon chen rnam gsum ste bshad zhol chang gsum sde srid kyi khrir mnga' gsol/spyi lo 1910/ lcags khyi/ (1)zla 1tshes 3nyin/ zi khron gyi skam dmag mdo smad gzhung lam 'ba' dang / li thang / tsha ba rong mdzar sogs brgyud bod phyogs su 'ongs/ zla 2par/ dmag dpung rnams kong po rgya mda' la 'byor te bod dmag dang 'thab pas bod dmag brgya lhag tsam srog shor/ de nas kra'o 'ar phung gi dmag dpung lha sar 'byor rjes zing cha tshabs chen langs/ (2)zla 1tshes 3nyin gyi nam phyed tsam du tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho rtse pho brang nas nor bu gling khar phebs/ de nas tā la'i bla ma dang / sde srid bka' blon dang bcas pa rgya gar du bros phebs/ (3)dus der khri pa blo bzang rgyal mtshan nas slar yang srid 'dzin mdzad/ de'i phyag rogs su sne shar mkhan chen mkhyen rab phun tshogs bskos thog tā la'i bla ma'i go gnas stsal/bka' tshab tu bsam pho dang / gung thang pa bcas bskos/ (4)paṇa chen dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma lha 'byor thog rgya bod bar zhi mthun yong ba'i bka' mol mdzad/sbyi lo 1911 / lcags phag (1)'di lo'i spyi zla 10pa'i tshes 10nyin/ sun krung hran gyis khyu'u khrung gyen langs bslangs te man ju gong ma'i srid gzhung la rgol bas gong ma'i srid gzhung kha thor zhing / de'i gyi lor krung ha ming go btsugs shing gong ma'i srid gzhung mjug rdzogs/ (2)'di lo ston khar/ tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho ka sbug tu phebs nas 'bras ljongs rgyal po'i spro khang du bzhugs/ (3)paṇa chen chos kyi nyi ma gtsang phyogs su phyir phebs/sbyi lo 1912/ chu byi/ (1)zla 6tshes 10nyin/ rgyal ba thub bstan rgya mtsho rdo rje gling nas bsam lding du chibs kha bsgyur/ rgya gar du yod chi

pa'i bod mi dang / dbyin ji/ 'bras ljongs pa sogs nas phebs skyel gsol ston gzab rgyas bshams/ zla 12tshes 16nyin/ chos yang nas tshag sgar brgyud rtse pho brang du phebs/ (2)zla 2tshes 15nyin/ kra'o 'ar phung gi dazlog dpung gis se ra dgon par dmag drangs/ zla 10tshes 30nyin/ dmag thag yongs su chod nas zi khron gyi dmag dpung lhag ma rnams rgya gar brgyad phyir log(3)spyi zla 6tshes 14nyin/ zi khron dang / yun nan gyi dmarno dpung bod da bskyod dgos pa'i bka' phab pa bzhin/ zi khron gyi dmag mi khag gcig khamathe khul du 'byor/spyi lo 1913 / chu glang / zla 10 tshes 13nyin/ sim la'i gros tshogs 'go tshugs/ tshogs 'dur zhugs mkhan gyi gras su krung dbyang srid gzhung gi sku tshab bod kyi sho'an h+pha hre dran dbyi phen dang / shongan h+pha hre gzhon pa wang had phen/ dbyin gar+shang gi sku tshab phyi 'brel blon chen rno kha ma hang dang / krung go'i las don gyi cha ces pa la'o si/ bod kyi las don gyi cha zlos pa spa'o yer/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi bshad sgra dpa' 'byor༄ rdo rje dang / las rogs thas ji khri smon pa sogs yod/spyi lo 1914/ shing stag (1)zla 5tshes 10nyin/ dbyin gzhung gi 'thus mi dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mis khrims 'gol gyis lkog tu sim la'i chings yig la ming rtags bkod/ (2) lo mjug tu tsha rong rta bzang dgra 'dul bod dmag gi dmag spyi dang / thas ji khri smon dmag spyi mkhan chung bsko bzhag dang 'brel bod dmag bcos sgrig thog dmag mi khri gcig btsugs/ (3)dbyin jis rgyal rtser dmag dpon slob grwa btsugs te kho pa tsho'i rjes 'brangs pa gso skyong byas/spyi lo 1915/ zhing yos/ rin sgang dang / smon grong / skyid 85

sbag sgog mkharabacas mtho rim gyi phru gu bzhi dbyin ji'i rgyal sa phun tun du sdug las dang / sbrag tar/ gter las/ dmag dpon bcas slob sbyong byed par btang / de'i 'go khrid du rtsis pa lung shar btang /sbyi lo 1916/ me 'drug lha ldan sman rtsis khang gsar du btsuṭa/de'i 'go khrid du mkhas dbang mkhyen rab nor bu bsko bzhag stsal ba dang /sa gnas khag nas bod phrug mang po bsda rub kyis rig gnas spyi dang / khyad ltar tho/na rtsis kyi gzhung lugs la sbyangs pa byas te sman rtsis lag rtsal mi sna mang spyi lo 1920/ lcags sprel/ bshad sgra dpal 'byor rdo rje dang /chang khyim tshe yi 'phen pa rdzogs/sbyi lo 1921 / lcags bya/ (1)bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis phogs khang las khungs gsar da btsugs/ (2)srid blo na zhol khang kher rkyang gis srid bskyangs/ d+kusbyi lo 1923/ chu phag (1)bod kyi 'thung ja yul phyogs gzhan nas 'dren mi dgos pa'i ched du ja chu rong du ja shing 'debs las kyi tshod lta byas/ de'i 'go khrid du ru dpon las tshan pa byams pa skal bzang bsko bzhag stsal/ (2)paṇa chen dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma dang / tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho 'gal rkyen ches cher song ste/ zla 11tshes 16nyin gyi mtshan mo paṇa chen dgu pa zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa byang lam brgyad mes rgyal nang khul da bros byol du phebs/ (3)lha sar pu li si'i dmar+sha sgar btsugs/ snya sa'i phyogs bzhir tsho khang bzhi dang / srang lam da nyen rtogs pa bzhag pa'i srol gtod/de'i 'go khrid da bsod nams legs (na nam legs ldan sa heb dang / rtse drang mkhyen rab kun༄ bzang bsko bzhag stsal/ cusbyi lo 1924/ shing byi/ lung shar rdo rje tshe rgyal gtsang du khrul 86

zhib tu thon/sbyi lo 1925/ shing glang / (1)sbrag khang dang / de rjes tar khang btsugs/ de'i 'go khrid du rtse drung grags pa chos rgyal dang / skad drung spel bzhi ba bskos/ (2)zi khron sa 'brel khul shis khams dmigs bsal sa khul zhes ming bsgyur byas/ (3)paṇa chen dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma pe cing du 'byor/de nas byang shar dang / nang sog nan cing / ha'ang kra'u/ mtsho sngon sogs mes rgyal gyi sa gnas khag la gzigs bskor gnas mjal du phebs/spyi lo 1926/ me stag (1)dbyin ji'i rjes 'brangs pa tsha rong rta bzang dgra 'dul gyis gsang ba'i tshogs pa btsugs te bod sa gnas kyi srid dbang mgo rting slog pa'i ngan byus bting stabs tsha rong bod dmag gi dmag spyi'i go gnas phab/ rgyal rtse dmag dpon slob grwa mtshams 'jog byas pa ma zad/ gsang ba'i sgrig 'dzugs nang zhugs mkhan dpon rigs rnams gnas dbyung btang / (2)srid blon zhol khang dgongs pa rdzogs te de'i las rogs glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug srid blon du bskos/ /spyi lo 1927/ me yos/ (1)rab byung bcu drug pa 'go tshugs/(2)rig gnas spyi dang / lhag par sman rtsis mkhas can mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gis rig ldan snying thig brtsams/sbyi lo 1928/ sa 'drug (1)dgun dus su tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis ma bskul dwangs blangs thog rgya nag ri bo rtse lngar bca' sdod bod kyi mkhan po blo bzang pa sangs dang / de rjes pe cing g.yi gyo kung ste dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan po dkon mchog 'byung gnas rnam gnyis nan cing du btang thog krung dbyang srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu ba'i rnam pa bstan/ (2)spro bo'i khrul rigs 'phar sgon dang / khrul gzhung gsar du bkod 87

rtsis byas stabs spo bo kuḥganam sde pa bdud 'dul nas rang nyid kyi dbang bsgyur sra brtan yong ched sa gnas srid gzhung dang dmag 'thab lan mang byas/spyi r+shatswa 1929/ sa sprul/ spo bo ka gnam sde pa bdad 'dal dmag pham nas g.yog 'ga' zhig khrid de rgya gar da bros/ dbyin jo'i dathen rigs hor sa heb la mgo btags/ cusbyi lo 1930/ lcags rta/ (1)dga' ldan byin chags gling gi mkhan po dkon mchog 'byung gnas nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi spyi khyab 'thus mir bsko bzhag (2)zla 12par/ bod sog u yon lhan khang gis 'thus mi she go le'ang dang / drung yig tha'an yun hran rgya gar brgyud bod du btang yang / 'thus mi she go le'ang chu shur du 'byor skabs dgongs pa rdzogs/ drung yig tha'an yun hran lha sar zla shas bsdod de phyir logaji r+shatswa 1931 / lcags lug tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho mchog gis tshul khrims bstan 'dzin sogs nan cing du mngags gtong thog nan cing du bca' sdod bod kyi don gcod khang dngos su btsugs/ krung dbyang srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung bar gyi 'brel ba sngar las 'thus sgo tshang du phyin/ji lo 1932/ chu sprel/ grong drag dmag dmag skul brgyab/sbyi lo 1933/ chu bya/ zla 10tshes 30nyin/ tā la thub bstan rgya mtsho bgrang bya 68la phebs te dgongs pa mya ngan las 'das/sbyi lo 1934 / shing khyi/ (1)drung rtsis tshogs 'du'i thog srid blon gsar bskos byed phyogs skor gros bsdar dang 'brel go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la gser snyan sgron pa bsnan/ rwa sbreng 'jam dpal ye shes srid blon dang glang mdun kun dga' dbang phyug srid blon las rogs bsko bzhag stsal/ (2)zla 4par/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis hong ma'o sung bod du btang / tā la thub bstan rgya mtshor hu go hang hā phu tshe yon 88

jo tā hre zhes pa'i rjes sgon cho lo dang / g.yang ṭi'i dam kha 'ja' sa bcas gnang / de bzhin gser gdung gi zhal 'debs kyang gang legs mdzad/spyi lo 1935/ shing phag 6tshes 5nyin gyi nyi shar mtshams su a mdo sku 'bum gyi shar smad stag 'tsher gyi sa'i char du yab cho cho rtsa ring dang / yum bsod nams mtsho'i sras su tā la'i yang srid bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho ska bltams/zhu sbyi lo 1937/ me glang / zla 10pa'i tshes 28nyin/ paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma bgrang bya 5 phebs te skye dgu mdor bde bar gshegs/sbyi lo 1938/ sa stag paṇa chen ska phreng bcu pa 'phrin las lhan grub chos kyi rgyal mtshan mtsho sngon du sku 'khrungs/༄ ༄sbyi r+shatswa 1939/ sa yos/ (1)zla 10tshes la/ tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar phebs/ (2)zla 10tshes 12nyin/ rgyal tshab rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes dang / mtshan zhabs dar han stag brag ngag dbang gsung rab gnyis nas yongs 'dzin che chung gi 'gan yongs su blangs/ tā la'i bla ma'i yang srid lha ldan gtsug lag khang du gdan drangs nas skra phud bzhes/ mtshan du 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang 'dus mtshungs pa med pa'i sde zhes ba/sol/spyi lo 1940/ lcags 'drug (1)zla 1 tshes 14nyin rtse pho brang du tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mi 'jigs gdong lnga'i khrir mnga' gsol/ go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gis 'u krung shin bod du gtong gnang mdzad de khri bzhugs mdzad sgo'i gtso skyong mdzad/ (2)krung dbyang srid 89

gzhung gis rwa sgreng 'jam dpal ye shes la h+phu go hung ho hran hre zhes pa'i cho lo gnang / (3)skyidadagu mdo nas paṇa chen dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma'i sku gdung bod du gdan drangs/spyi lo 1941 / lcags sprul/ zla 1tshes 1 nyin/ rwa sgreng gnas skabs ring srid blon dgongs zhu mdzad thog stag brag gsung rab bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan srid blon gyi khrir 'khod/spyi lo 1942/ chu rta/ zla 5tshes 23nyin/ dbyin ji'i rjes 'brangs pa stag brag sogs kyis khrims 'gal gyi sgo nas phyi 'brel las khungs btsugasaspyi/ lo 1943/ chu lug mon zhib mda' dpon bying pa ba dang /rtse mgron phun rab pa gnyis nas zhib gzhung gsar du bkod/sbyi lo 1944/ shing sprel/ (1)dbyin jis dmag mi btang ste rang re'i rdza yul smad kyi wa lung la btsan 'dzul byas/ (2)dbyin ji dpon dmag rdi rang khong sbrang nang 'tsho drug dang / rong nang stod smad du 'ongs nas bod kyi khrul rigs bsda bar bkag 'gog byas/spyi lo ༄1947/ me phag (1)rgya gar rdo li gsar par bskong tshogs byas pa'i ya gling gros tshogs thog bod sger btsan rgyal khab cig tu brtsis nas tshogs 'dur zhugs pa ma zad/ bod dmag gi dmag dar gangs ri dang seng ge rtags can de rgyal dar da brtsis te bskyal ba sogs mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i bya spyod mang tsam spel༄/ (2)zla 2par/ zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / lha klu tshe dbang rdo rjes bod dmag nyis brgya lhag tsam 'khrid de rwa sgreng dgon par rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes 'dzin bzung byed par bskyod/ (3)ser byes grwa tshang gis rwa sgreng gi rgyab langs byas pa sogs la brten se ra dang / bod sa gnas srid gzhung bar dmag 'khrug langs/ zla 390

tshes 8nyin/ bod dmag gis se ra blangs/ thengs 'dir se ra'i grwa pa dgu bcu lhag tsam bsad/ grwa pa mang po mas/ byed gte bcu phrag 'ga' zhig 'dzin bzung thog khrims gcod drag po btang / (4)zla 3par/ rwa sgreng thub bstan 'jam dpal ye shes rtse shar chen ltog tu bkrongs/ (5)zla 10par/rtsis dpon zhwa sgab pa dbang phyug bde ldan dang / rim bzhi spom mda' yar 'phel/ zur khang mda' dpon sogs bod kyi tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa zer ba sgrig 'dzugs bzos/sbyi lo 1948/ sa byi/ zhwa skab pa dbang phyug bde ldan sogs tshong don brtag zhib tshogs pa'i 'thus mi rnams nan cing du 'byor/ de nas go min tang srid gzhung gi bka' la ma brtsis par kho pa tshos hang gang brgyud a ri dang / dbyin ji sogs rgyal khab khag la bskyod de bod mes rgyal gyi mnga' khongs nas kha bral gtong ba'i lkog g.yo mang po byas/sbyi lo 1949/ sa glang / (1)zla catshes 8nyin/ btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi ngan skul 'og bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung gi lha sar bca' sdod khang phyir 'then dgos pa'i bka' phab pa dang / skyid 'dod slob grwar sgo dam brgyab pa/ bod sdod rgya rigs yongs rdzogs phyir 'bud pa sogs bya spyod ngan pa mang tsam spel/ (2)zla 8par/a ri btsan rgyal ring lugs pas so pa'i 'go gtso la'o 'ar thang mu si bod du btang / krung go'i nang srid la the byus kyis bod kyi mtho rim 'og spyod par ngan skul mang tsam byas/ (3)spyi zla 10tshes 1nyin/ krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dngos su dbu brnyes paṇa chen er te ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan mchog nas tar gtong mdzad de krung ha mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes par rten 'brel zhus pa dang / krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung la brtsi bkur zhu 9

ba'i rnam pa bstan pa ma zad/ bod gang myur bcing bkrol yong ba'i re ba'ang zhu gnang mdzad/spyi lo 1950/ lcags stag (1)zla 7ches 24nyin/ dge stag rin po che chab mdo sa khul du phebs te 'brel yod khag la gang ci'i bka' slob yang yang gnang ba ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma'i gser zhal mjal te bod zhi ba'i bcing bkrol gtong lugs skor gros mol zhu dgos pa'i re ba bton stabs/btsan rgyal ring lugs pa dang / bod kyi mtho rim log spyod pa dngangs skrag dang 'khon 'dzin cig car du 'char nas zla 8tshes 22nyin/ dbyin ji'i gsang nyul h+phu theg dug btang nas bkrongs/ (2)zla 10tshes 7nyin/ mi dmangs bcing bkrol dmag bod bskyod dmag dpung gis chab mdor dpung 'jug byed 'go tshugs te/ tshes 16nyin chab mdo yongs su blangs/ bod dmag dang yul dmag lnga stong bdun brgya so brgyad tsam rtsa gtor btang / (3)zla 10tshes 11 nyin/ ta dang mda' dpon sde dge skal bzang dbang 'dus 'go dmag dang bcas pas mar khams su 'os langs byas/ (4)zla 10tshes 8nyin/ tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos lugs gnyis kyi 'gan yongs su bzhes/ stag brag srid blon dgongs pa zhus/ (5)zla 11tshes 11 nyin/ mkhan chen blo bzang bkra shis dang / rtsis dpon klu khang ba tshe dbang rab brtan la srid tshab bsko bzhag dang / de 'bral tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa gro mor bros byol du phebs/ spyi lo 1951 / lcags yos/ (1)zla 2par/ nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med dang / khe smad bsod nams dbang 'dus/ thub bstan bstan dar/thub bstan legs smon/ bsam pho bstan 'dzin don grub bcas bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi pe cing du ched gtong mdzad de zla 4pa'i nang snga rjes 92

su pe cing du bde 'byor byung / zla 4tshes 29nyin/ spung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung dang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'thus mi rnams zhi ba'i gros mol gnang 'go tshugs te/ spyi zla 6tshes 23nyin bod zhi ba'i bcing bkrol byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la dngos su ming rtags bkod/(2)spyi zla 5tshes 24nyin/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi kru'u zhi ma'o tse tung mchog gis gsol ston rgya che gzab rgyas bshams te bod zhi ba'i bcings bkrol byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags bkod par rten 'brel zhu gnang mdzad/ gsol ston thog ma'o tse tung kru'u zhis gal che'i gsung bshad gnang ba ma zad/ paṇa chen er te ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med rnam gnyis nas snga rjes su gsung bshad kyang gnang ba red/ (3)spyi zla 6tshes 13nyin/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi bod bzhugs sku tshab dmag dpon chen po grang cin u rgyal sa pe cing nas bod du thon/ (4)spyi zla /tshes 14nyin/ dmag dpon chen po krang cin chu gro mor phebs/ tshes 17nyin/ gro mor tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang mjal 'phrad gnang ba ma zad/ ma'o kru'u zhi'i phyag bris phyag bstar ma zhig phul ba dang / mdza' mthun gyi gsung mol yun ring gnang / (6)spyi zla 8tshes 8nyin/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi dmag dpon chen po krang cin spu sku 'khor dang bcas pa lha sar 'byor/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs khag dang / bod dmag rgya che'i mi dmangs bcas kyis bsu ba gzab rgyas zhus/ (6)spyi zla 8tshes 17nyin/ tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho sku 'khor zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa lha sar bde 'byor byung / (7)spyi zla 10tshes 24nyin/ tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos ma'o kru'u zhir tar yig phul te/ bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi ser skya dpon rigs dang / bod kyi 93

mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs nas sems thag gtsang bcad kyis gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la brtsi bkur zhu rgya yin zhes gsungs/ (8)spyi zla 10tshes 26nyin/ dmag dpon chen po kra/ go hā dang / tha'an kon san rnam gnyis kyis sne 'khrid gnang ba'i bod bskyod mi dmangs bcing bkrol dmag lha sar bde 'byor byung / (9)zla 12tshes 1nyin/ dmag dpon chen po phen ming dang /chu'u hra'ang krung rnam gnyis nas sne 'khrid mdzad pa'i bod bskyod mi dmangs bcings bkrol dmag gi dpung sde khag gcig lha sar 'byor/ (10)spyi zla 12tshes 19nyin/ paṇa chen er te ni chos kyi rgyal mtshan zi ling nas chibs kha bsgyur te bod du phebs/spyi lo 1952/ chu 'khrug (1)spyi zla 1 tshes 10nyin/ krung gung bod las don u yon lhan khang dngos su btsugs/ krang cin u hru'u ci dang / krang go hā dang / tha'an kon san/ phen ming bcas rgya'u ci gzhon pa/wang ji ma'i dang / chu'u hra'ang krung / dran ming dbyi/ li 'jo/ phun tshogs dbang rgyal/ rmā han krang bcas u yon du bsko bzhag stsal/ (2)spyi zla 2tshes 10nyin/ krung go mi dmangs bcing bkrol dmag bod dmag khul khang dngos su btsugs/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gsar brje'i dmag don u yon lhan khang gi krang go hā si ling yon dang / nga phod ngag dbang 'jigs med si ling yon gzhon pa ang dang po/ mdo mkhar phun tshogs rab rgyas si ling yon gzhon pa ang gnyis pa/ khrung spang kud si ling yon gzhon pa ang gsum pa/ tha'an kon san chab srid u yon dang / phen ming dang wang ji ma'i chab srid u yon gzhon pa bcas la bsko bzhag stsal/ (3)spyi zla 4tshes 27nyin/ srid tshab mkhan chen blo bzang bkra shis dang / klu khang ba tshe dbang rab brtan gnyis nas mes rgyal kha bral gtong ba'i g.yo sgyu'i sbyor ba mang tsam byas 94

stabs gnas dbyang btang / (4)spyi zla 4tshes 28nyin/ paṇa chen er te ni mchog dang sku cu'akhor zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa lha sar 'byor te rtse pho brang chen po po tā lar tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang zhal 'dzoms gnang /(5)spyi zla 6tshes 4nyin/ krung go dmangs gtso ring lugs gsar pa'i gzhon nu sde tshogs bod las don u yon lhan khang dngos su btsugs/ (6)spyi zla 9tshes 8nyin/ lha sa mi dmangs sman khang dngos su btsugs te bod kyi mi rigs khag gi mi dmangs la phan pa rgya cher mdzad/ (7)spyi zla 12tshes 1nyin/bod dmag khul khang las byed slob grwa dngos su tshugs/sbyi lo 1953/ chu sprul/ (1)spyi zla 1tshes 13nyin/ lha sa grong khyer rgyal gces gzhon nu shes rig mthun grogs tshogs pa dngos su btsugs/ (2)spyi zla 2tshes 24nyin/ tā la'i bla ma'i pe cing du bca' sdod don gcod khang dngos su btsugs/ (3)spyi zla 9par/ lha sa grong khyer skud yod glog 'phrin las khungs rgyang bsgrags gtong 'go tshugs/ (4)spyi tshogs slob grwa dngos su 'go tshugs/sbyi lo 1954/ zhing rta/ (1)spyi zla 3tshes 8nyin/ lha sa grong khyer rgyal gces bud med mnyam 'brel tshogs pa dngos su dbu brnyes/ (2)spyi zla 12tshes 2nyin/ lha sa skyid chu'i zam chen rgyag 'go tshugs/ (3)spyi zla 12tshes 24nyin/ khams bod dang / mtsho bod rlangs 'khor 'gro lam shar gtong thub par lha sar mdzad sgo rgya che gzab rgyas tshogs/sbyi lo 1955/ zhing lug (1)spyi zla 4tshes 5nyin/ lha sa skyid chu'i zam chen dngos su legs bsgrubs zin/ (2)spyi zla 9tshes 15nyin/ a lo chos mdzad sogs kyis mi dmangs kyi 'thug mi yin khul gyis bcos bsgyur dang / bod dmag la bsgyur bcos byed rgyu sogs la ngo rgol byed pa'i yi ge phul/96

sbyi lo 1956/ me sprel/ (1)spyi zla 3tshes 16nyin/ krung dbyang mi dmangs srid gzhung gi 'thus mi tshogs pa'i tshogs gartsa rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tsung li gzhon pa dran dbyi pe cing nas phebs rdog thon te bod la phebs/(2)spyi zla 4 tshes 17nyin/ krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso tsung li gzhon pa dran dbyi mchog gis sne 'khrid gnang ba'i 'thus mi tshogs pa lha sar 'byor/ (3)ma'o kru'u zhi dang / spu yon krang li'u hra'o chi/ tsung li kra'u en le bcas kyis bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su btsugs par rten 'brel zhu ba'i tar gtong gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gis rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang gi u yon rnams bsko bzhag stsal/ (4)spyi zla 4tshes 22nyin/ lha sa'i tshogs khang chen mor bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su dbu brnyes pa'i mdzad sgo'i rten 'brel gzab rgyas tshogs pa dang / tshogs chen thog kru'u ren u yon tā la'i bla ma bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yis bod rang skyong ljongs grwa sgrig u yon lhan khang dngos su dbu brnyes pa'i khyab bsgrags gnang ba dang / krung dbyang sku tshab tshogs pa'i tshogs gtso dang / rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi tsung li gzhon pa dran dbyis rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi bka' yig sgrog sbyang gnang ba ma zad/ rgyal srid spyi khyab khang gi sku tshab mdzad de srid dam stsal ba red/

rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis kyi re'u migargyal phran gyi ming / rje bo'i ming / blon po'i ming /mchims yul gru bul/ mchims rje gu yong / blon snang dang ding /zhang zhung yul/ rgyal po lig snya bur/ blon po rma dang ra sang /myang ro khyod dkar/ gtsang rje thong dkar/ blon po gnang /gnubs yul gling / snubs rje dmigs pa/ blon po rme'u dang 'bro/thang ro sham bo/ rngam rje 'brom/ blon po she su gnyis/kyi ri ljon sngon/ kyi ri rmang po/ blon po ngam dang 'bro/ngam shong khra sna/ zing shā /ma 'phrang blon / nya/gar dang 'ol spang mkhar/ zing rje thon phreng / blon sbaX rngog dang gri'i rol mo gong / brang rje gong nam/ blon zhudi sabad dang kong yul bre sna/ kong rje kur po tug blon po mkhar ba/nyang yul rnam gsum/ nyang btsun glang rgyal/ blon ngopo rjebug dang dwags yul gru bzhi/ dwags rje mang po rgyal/ blon shā nyiXngs skam 97

gsal bshad/gnya' khri btsan po'i gong du bod la rgyal phran sil ma bcu gnyis dang /de rjes rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcur gyur zhes deb ther mang por gsal yang /rgyal phran sil ma bzhi bcu'i ming ni deb ther khag tshang mar gsal bar 'khod mi 'dug pas/ 'dir re'u mig tu bkod med/
